articles.title: Wix Retail POS: Selling Physical Gift Cards
articles.html_content:
Important:
  • This article is about Wix Retail POS tablet for brick & mortar businesses. 
  • For info on using POS on a mobile device, click here.
You can sell physical gift cards and let customers use them to complete purchases. It's a cost-effective way to keep customers coming back and a great for attracting new buyers.
Important:
Wix physical gift cards are currently available in the US and Canada to merchants who use Wix Retail POS to sell in their brick-and-mortar businesses.

Step 1 | Order physical gift cards

To get started, design and order your cards. You can do so in your site's computer dashboard (currently available to US merchants only) or through eCard Systems.
Tips:
  • The Wix gift cards do not have a set dollar value. You assign the value when you sell the physical gift card to your customer (see below).
  • You also have the option of ordering other gift cards and selling them. Note that the gift cards must have codes that are between 8 and 16 characters long (numbers or letters) for you to be able to use them at your point of sale.

To order gift cards:

Order cards in the Wix dashboard

Note: This option is currently available only for merchants based in the US.

  1. Go to gift card templates in your site's dashboard.
  2. Hover over a template and click Customize to select it.
  3. Customize your gift card:
    1. Click Customize.
    2. Add, edit, or delete any of the available elements.
      Tip: To switch to a solid color background, select the background image and set the opacity to 0%, then click Change Background to select a background color.
    3. Click Switch to Back at the bottom to design the back of the card.
    4. Click Done.
  4. Select an option from the Paper Type drop-down.
  5. Select the number of cards you want to purchase from the Quantity drop-down.
  6. Click Add to Cart.
  7. Click Continue to Checkout.
  8. Add your shipping details.
  9. Click Save & Continue.
  10. Add your payment details.
  11. Click Submit Purchase.

Order cards through eCard Systems

  1. Go to the gift card order page.
  2. Click the Choose your card finish drop-down and select an option: Gloss Laminate or Satin Matte Laminate.
  3. Select a Production Time.
  4. Select an artwork option from the Tell us about your card artwork drop-down:
    • I will provide a press-ready card design: You upload an image that is ready to be printed.
    • I'd like to use eCard's custom design service: You upload an image and eCard Systems will improve the design to make it suitable for print.
    • I will use artwork from a previous order: Select an image you uploaded for a previous order.
  5. (Optional) Enter art layout instructions in the field provided.
  6. (Optional) Enter custom text that appears on the back of the card. Tip: If you leave this section blank, default text appears. This includes your business's address, phone number, and website URL. 
  7. Upload a card image:
    1. Click Choose File.
    2. Select an image and click Open.
  8. Select the number of cards you want to print.
  9. Click Add to Cart.
  10. Click Proceed to Checkout and complete the order. Note: Before the cards are printed, eCard Systems, will contact you so you can approve the gift card design.
Note:
Check the FAQ section below for info on file types and sizes that you can upload to eCard.

Step 2 | Enable gift cards in your dashboard

Before you can start selling gift cards at your point of sale, you need to go to your Wix dashboard and enable gift cards for your site.

To enable gift cards:

  1. Go to Gift Cards in your site's dashboard. 
  2. Click Add Gift Card to Site.
Tip:
After clicking Add Gift Card to Site, you do not need to do anything else in the dashboard page or the Editor in order to continue physical gift card setup.

Step 3 | Sell physical gift cards

Once you receive the gift cards you ordered and enabled gift cards in the dashboard, you can start selling physical gift cards to customers.

To sell gift cards:

  1. Open the POS tablet. 
  2. Tap Checkout from the menu bar at the bottom.
  3. Tap Gift Cards.
  4. Tap Issue gift card.
  5. Select the actual gift card (i.e. the plastic card) that you want to sell to your customer.
  6. Select an option:
    • Scan the card's code.
    • Manually enter the card's code.
      Tip: Gift card codes are not case sensitive.
  7. Enter the value of the gift card (up to $1000).
  8. Tap Add to Cart.
  9. Complete checkout as you would for any product.

Step 4 | Accept payment of physical gift cards

When customers want to pay for their order using their gift card, you need to select Gift Card as the payment method. 

To accept gift card payment:

  1. Open the POS tablet. 
  2. Tap Checkout on the bottom bar. 
  3. Process the sale and proceed to checkout.
  4. Select Gift Card under Select Payment Method.
  5. Enter or scan the gift card code and tap Apply.
  6. (If the gift card didn't cover the entire purchase) Click Add Payment and process the balance using another payment method, like cash or a credit card.

FAQs

I have my own gift cards. Can I sell them and accept them as gift card payment?

Yes. Simply skip "Step 1 | Order physical gift cards" in the instructions above, and follow the rest of the instructions. 
Important: The gift cards must have codes that are between 8 and 16 characters long. The characters must be either numbers or letters.

What are the image size and file type requirements?

You can upload images of the following types:
  • .png (Wix gift cards only)
  • .gpg (Wix gift cards only)
  • .jpeg
  • .tiff
  • .eps (eCard Systems only)
  • Adobe PhotoShop file types
  • Adobe Illustrator file types
  • Adobe InDesign file types
  • Other print-quality pdf file formats  

The minimum file size is 300 dpi and the maximum is 50 MB.

How can I be sure my gift card looks OK before it's printed?

  • Wix gift cards: Our team reviews every order before it's sent to production. We'll reach out if we find any issues. 
  • eCard Systems: An eCard Systems representative will contact you so you can approve the gift card design before they create them.

How long does it take for my gift cards to arrive?

Once the card design is approved, it takes approximately 15 days to produce them and 3 - 7 days to ship.

I ordered Wix gift cards. Can I cancel the order or request a refund?

Wix gift card orders are fulfilled by Order a Print. 
  • Cancel an order: You can cancel an order by writing to support@orderaprint.com within the first 24 hours of placing your order. 
  • Request a refund: If the cards you received were damaged or defective, send an email to support@orderaprint.com to report the problem within seven days of delivery. Order a Print will investigate and send a replacement at their discretion.

Who can I contact about my gift card shipment?

Contact 
  • Wix gift cards: Contact our partner, Order a Print.
  • Ecard Systems: Contact eCard Systems customer service.

I don't see the option to pay by gift card. How can I add it?

If Gift Card does not appear as a payment option, make sure this function is enabled.

To enable payment by gift card:
  1. Open the POS tablet.
  2. Tap the Menu icon  at the bottom left.
  3. Tap Settings.
  4. Tap Payment.
  5. Click the Accept Gift Cards toggle to enable it.

Can customers who buy physical gift cards use them for purchases on my site?

Yes. Each gift card comes with a code. When your customer gets to the payment part of the checkout, they select the Redeem a gift card checkbox and enter the code.

Can I add to the balance of a gift card that's already purchased?

It's not possible to add money to an existing gift card. Customers would need to purchase a new card to increase their balance.

Can I offer refunds or exchanges for orders paid for with a gift card?

It's not currently possible to provide a refund for products purchased with a gift card. You can, however, allow your customer to exchange products. 

My customer wants to return the card they bought. Can I refund the card purchase?

No, gift cards orders are not refundable.

question: How can I improve my site's performance when displaying a large amount of items on a repeater or table in Wix CMS?
answer:
To improve your site's performance when displaying a large amount of items on a repeater or table in Wix CMS, you can adjust the **Maximum items displayed** field in your dataset settings to [control the number of items that can load](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-changing-the-maximum-items-displayed-in-your-dataset-settings) at a time. This helps you load your page faster with fewer items on the initial page load, reduce the number of larger items, and enhance your page's design.

Additionally, if you have a large amount of content to show on data-bound elements, it is recommended to limit the amount of items that are loaded at once, and add a “[Load More](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-about-dataset-click-actions-for-buttons-and-images#load-more)” button or a [pagination bar](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-adding-and-setting-up-a-pagination-bar), which will load one batch of such items at a time. A good practice would be to show up to 10 items with every new load.

If your repeaters need to contain a lot of content or be connected to a large collection, consider using a deferred dataset. These datasets load the connected content only after the rest of the page loads, which can improve your site's performance. [Learn more](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-setting-up-a-deferred-dataset).

If there is content in your collection that is not needed on your page, you can stop it from being displayed by [adding a filter to the dataset](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-formerly-content-manager-adding-filters-and-sorts-to-datasets-to-control-live-site-content) and choosing what content to display.

question: How can I add and customize a decorative shape or line in the Wix Editor?
answer:
To add a decorative shape or line in the Wix Editor, follow these steps:

1. Click **Add Elements** on the left side of the editor.
2. Click **Decorative**.
3. Drag a shape, arrow, or line onto your page.
4. (Optional) Use the available options to customize the shape, arrow, or line.

You can customize the color and border, resize it, or even turn it into a button. To customize the design of your line, click the line in your editor, click **Change Design**, and then click **Customize Design**. Different line designs have different customization options.

question: How can I add a watermark to my photos in Wix Photo Albums?
answer:
To add a watermark to your photos in Wix Photo Albums, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Photo Albums](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Go%20to%20Photo%20Albums&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https:%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Fdashboard%2F%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D%2Fphotography-albums/?referralInfo=KB_Article) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **Manage Album** next to the relevant album.
3. Click the drop-down in the **Watermark** section to expand it.
4. Enable the **Add watermark** toggle.
5. Select the **Images**, **Gallery thumbnails** or **Cover** checkboxes to choose where your watermark is displayed.
6. (Optional) Click **Customize watermark** and choose how you'd like your watermark to look:
   * Click **Upload Watermark** to upload an image file from your computer.
   * Drag the **Opacity** slider to change the transparency of the watermark.
   * Drag the **Size** slider to change the watermark's size.

question: How can I enable shipping to pickup points using Boxtal in my Wix store?
answer:
### Prerequisites
Ensure that you have added the Boxtal app and set up your Boxtal account as described in Steps 1 and 2.

### To enable shipping to pickup points via Boxtal:
1. [Go to Shipping & Fulfillment](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Shipping&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/store/shipping-and-tax/list?referralInfo=sidebar) in your site's dashboard.

7. Click **Save**.
8. Repeat steps 2 - 6 for any additional shipping regions (e.g. Spain).

articles.title: Wix Stores: Offering Delivery to Pickup Points with Boxtal
articles.html_content:
Let customers buy online and pick up their purchases from convenient locations nearby. With Boxtal, merchants based in France can offer delivery to 10 countries via 15 carriers including Mondial Relay, Relais Colis, and FedEx.
After setup, customers in relevant regions can select one of 5 pickups points that are closest to the address they entered during checkout. 
When the order comes in, go to the Boxtal dashboard to purchase a shipping label. After dropping the package off at one of the carrier's pickup points, the carrier delivers the order to the pickup point the customer selected. Both you and your customer receive notifications and tracking numbers.

Step 1 | Add the Boxtal app

To get started, go to the Wix app market in the dashboard and add the Boxtal app. 

To add the Boxtal app:

  1. ﻿Go to the Wix App Market.
  2. Search for the Boxtal app.
  3. Click +Add to Site to add the app.
  4. Review permissions and click Add to Site.

Step 2 | Set up your Boxtal account

To start setting up shipping to pickup points, you need to access the Boxtal dashboard, create or sign in to your account, and add some basic information. 

To access the Boxtal dashboard:

  1. If not directed automatically:
    1. Go to Manage Apps in your site's dashboard in Wix.
    2. Click Open next to the Boxtal app.
  2. Create an account or log in to an existing account.
  3. (Optional) Switch languages:
    1. Click the Menu icon at the top right.
    2. Select a language icon at the bottom.
  4. Make sure your Wix store is connected to Boxtal. You should see your connected Wix Store with a green status indicator.
    Note: If you don't, click the Menu icon at the top right, select E-shops, click Wix and add it.
  1. Click the Edit icon  next to your site. 
  2. Enter your store's name.
  3. Select the I would like to let my clients pick their parcel point on their own in my checkout icon.
  4. Select the carriers you want to work with from the Which parcel point network would you like to show drop-down.
Notes:
  • To learn how to configure shipping parameters, create shipping rules, and more, go to the Boxtal Help Center.
  • Pickup point shipping isn't available for customers until you enable it (Step 4 below). 

Step 3 | Create shipping regions for each pickup-point location

To offer pickup-point delivery in a country or group of countries, you need to create a shipping region in your Wix dashboard.
For example, to offer pickup-points to customers in France and Spain, you need to create shipping regions in your Wix dashboard for each of those locations (or one location that covers both countries). 

Step 4 | Enable shipping to pickup points

For customers to see and select the new pickup point options at checkout, you must enable the Boxtal app in your Wix dashboard and set the rate you charge your customers. 
Important:
You must enable the pickup points in each region where you want customers to see it. 

To enable shipping to pickup points via Boxtal:

  1. Go to Shipping & Fulfillment in your site's dashboard.
  2. Select a shipping region where Boxtal operates (e.g. France).
  3. Scroll down past any shipping, delivery, or store pickup options you created.
  4. Click the toggle next to the Boxtal app to enable it. 
  5. Enter a Shipping option name (e.g. Pickup Points).
    Tip: Customers see this name during checkout.
  6. Enter the Rate at checkout.
  7. Click Save.
  8. Repeat steps 2 - 6 for any additional shipping regions (e.g. Spain).

Step 5 | Fulfill pickup-point orders

When customers check out, they can select any of the 5 available pickup points near the address they entered.
In the Orders tab, you can see an indication that this order is set to be delivered to a pickup point. You can also see the address of the specific pickup point your customer selected and the carrier set to fulfil the order. 
For example, in the image below, the carrier is Chronopost and that carrier is set to deliver the package to a pickup point called DREAM FLOWER, located at 63 rue Saint Martin. 

To fulfill a pickup point order:

  1. Go to the Boxtal dashboard
    1. Go to Manage Apps in your site's dashboard in Wix.
    2. Click Open next to the Boxtal app.
  2. Click the Shipping tab at the top. 
  3. Click Synchronize my shops to see the latest orders.
  4. Purchase a shipping label for your order.
  5. Physically deliver your customer's package to one of the carrier's pickup points.
    Note: As soon as the label is scanned by the carrier, a tracking number should be added to the order in the Wix tab and notifications are sent to you and your customer. If a tracking number isn't added automatically, you can manually add it to the order. 
Note:
Orders appear in the Boxtal dashboard only after an order is paid.

FAQs

In which countries does Boxtal offer pickup points?

Boxtal is available to Merchants in France. 
Using Boxtal you can deliver to pickup points near customers in the following regions: 
  • Belgium
  • France
  • Italy
  • Germany
  • Luxembourg
  • Netherlands
  • Portugal
  • Spain
  • Sweden
  • United Kingdom

What carriers does Boxtal use to deliver to pickup points?

Boxtal uses a variety of carriers to deliver to pickup points including:
  • Chronopost
  • Colissimo
  • DHL
  • FedEx
  • Happy Post
  • Lettre Suivie
  • Mondial Relay
  • Relais Colis
  • TNT
  • UPS

Can I offer delivery to pickup points for product subscriptions?

If you sell products as product subscriptions, you cannot offer delivery to pickup points for those subscription orders.

How can I get more information about what I can do in Boxtal?

Boxtal offers a wide range of settings and services. To learn more, go to the Boxtal Help Center.

How can I change the language in the Boxtal dashboard.

Click the Menu icon at the top right and select a language.

Can I connect the same Boxtal account to more than one website?

No, each site must be connected to a separate Boxtal account. You can, however, create multiple Boxtal accounts and connect each one to a different site. 

Can I charge different rates for different pickup point regions?

Currently, you can only set a flat rate for all deliveries to pickup points. 

How can customers select a pickup point that isn't near their home address?

The 5 pickup points offered to customers are the ones nearest the address they enter during checkout. If a customer wants to select a pickup point near their work address, for instance, they can enter the work address during checkout.

Customizing your AI Site-Chat layout

articles.title: Customizing the Cart Page
articles.html_content:
Important:
This article is relevant for Wix Stores, Wix Bookings, and Wix Restaurants Orders (New).
Similar to a shopping cart in a supermarket, your Cart Page is where customers place items they are interested in buying. When they're done browsing, they can proceed to checkout and complete the order.
In this article, learn more about:
  • Accessing the Cart page settings
  • Customizing the settings of your Cart page
  • Designing your Cart page
  • Editing text on the Cart page
  • Customizing the Cart page on mobile
  • Frequently asked questions (FAQs)

Accessing the Cart page settings

Access to the Cart page varies according to which business solution(s) you use:
  • Wix Stores: The Cart page is one of your Store pages.
  • Wix Bookings: The Cart page is one of your Bookings pages.
  • Wix Restaurants or any combination of solutions: The Cart page is listed under Cart & Thank You.
Wix Editor
Studio Editor
  1. Go to your editor.
  2. Click Pages & Menu  on the left side of the editor.
  3. Select an option:
    • My site has only Wix Stores:
      1. Click Store Pages.
      2. Click Cart Page.
    • My site has only Wix Bookings:
      1. Click Bookings Pages.
      2. Click Cart Page.
    • My site has Wix Restaurants Orders (New) / 2 business solutions:
      1. Click Cart & Thank You.
      2. Click Cart Page.
  4. Click the Cart Page element on your page.
  5. Click Settings.
  1. Go to your editor.
  2. Go to your Cart page:
  3. Click Pages  on the left side of the editor.
  4. Select an option:
    • My site has only Wix Stores:
      1. Click Store Pages.
      2. Click Cart Page.
    • My site has only Wix Bookings:
      1. Click Bookings Pages.
      2. Click Cart.
    • My site has Wix Restaurants Orders (New) / 2 business solutions:
      1. Click Cart & Thank You.
      2. Click Cart Page.
  5. Click the Cart Page element on your page.
  6. Click Settings.

Customizing the settings of your Cart page

Choose what you want to display on the Cart page. For example, you can choose to hide the "Enter a promo code" link if you don't offer coupons, or the "Add a note" link if there's no need for customers to leave you notes.

To customize your settings:

  1. Go to the Cart page in your editor.
  2. Click the Cart Page element.
  3. Click Settings.
  4. Click the Settings tab. 
  5. Select the relevant checkbox(s) according to the information you'd like to display:
    • Shipping & delivery rates: Displays delivery info relevant to the customer's location.
      Tip: If you use only Wix Bookings, we recommend unchecking this option.
    • Tax Costs: Displays the relevant tax estimation based on your customer's location.
      Note: Estimated taxes aren't displayed when you include tax in the product price. 
    • Promo code link: Allows customers to enter coupon codes.
      Note: If selected, the promo code link appears on the Checkout Page, as well.
    • Add a note: Customers can click to leave you a message.
      Note: Learn more about viewing customer notes. 
  6. Customize the Continue Browsing link:
    1. Click Show link under Continue Browsing Link to show or hide the link. 
    2. If enabled, click Link iconto select where the link directs to.
  1. Click the Show buttons toggle under Express Checkout to show or hide them:
    • Enabled: If you set up an express checkout payment provider (e.g. PayPal), an extra checkout button (e.g. PayPal button) is displayed. This directs customers to complete checkout there. Learn more
    • Disabled: Only the "Checkout" button is displayed.
Tips:
  • If you use Wix Restaurant Orders, you need to disable the Express Checkout option.
  • When the cart is empty, it always displays the "Continue Browsing" link.

Designing your Cart page

Customize the design of the Cart page so it matches your site's overall look and feel. You have full control of the way this page looks, including the colors, fonts, buttons, links, and more.  

To design your Cart Page:

  1. Go to the Cart page in your editor.
  2. Click the Cart Page element.
  3. Click Settings.
  4. Click the Design tab. 
  5. (Optional) Click the Stretch to full width toggle to enable it.
  6. Customize the design settings of the following areas: 
    • Background and Borders: Change the color of the page's background and dividers. 
    • Text Font & Color: Change the color and font of the page's title, body, and links.
    • Buttons: Change the color, style and appearance of buttons on the Cart Page. 
    • Payment methods: Design the express checkout buttons (e.g. PayPal). 
Tips:
  • To optimize the way the cart displays on mobile, make sure that the mobile page background color and cart background color are the same.
  • If you go to the mobile editor and change the page background, it doesn't affect the background color on desktop. 

Editing your Cart Page text

Adjust the text that appears on your Cart Page so it has the same tone and voice as the rest of your site. You can edit titles and buttons on the page.
You can also add a short message that appears between the total and your checkout button.

To edit your Cart Page text:

  1. Go to the Cart page in your editor.
  2. Click the Cart Page element.
  3. Click Settings.
  4. Click the Text tab. 
  5. Edit any of the text options.
  6. (Optional) Add a disclaimer: Enter a short message (max. 90 characters).
    Tip: This message appears under the total in the order summary.

Customizing the Cart Page on mobile

Decide where you want to display the checkout button for customers viewing your site on mobile. Choose from just displaying it only at the bottom of the page or display it at both the top and the bottom.
In the Studio Editor:
Many customizations are available for the mobile breakpoint in the Studio Editor, however, it's not possible to select where to display the Checkout button.

To customize the cart on mobile:

  1. Click the Switch to mobile icon  at the top of the editor.
  2. Click the Cart Page in the mobile Editor. 
  3. Click Settings.
  4. Select a placement option for the checkout button.

FAQs

Click a question below to learn more about the Cart page. 

How can I view the cart with items in it so I can see what I'm designing?

The Cart page looks different when it's empty and when there are items in it. If the cart is empty, you can add a store product or restaurant menu item to the cart to help you design how it looks when there are items in the Cart page.

Note: It's not currently possible to add a Wix Bookings service to the cart in preview mode.

To add an item to the cart in the editor:
  1. Click Preview at the top right corner of your editor.
  2. Go to a shop page or your restaurant's online ordering page.
  3. Add an item to the cart.
  4. Click the Cart Icon and click through to the Cart page. 
  5. Click Back to Editor at the top right to return to editor mode.

What will customers see if I enable Express Checkout?

You can connect to PayPal or Apple Pay as payment providers. When you do, you can display the buttons as express checkout options.

Enabling Express Checkout will add a checkout button to the Cart Part:


and the Checkout Page:


If you use Wix Stores and enabled the "Buy Now" button in the Product Page, you can also display express buttons there. 

Tip: If you selected an express payment option along with an additional option (e.g. manual payment, Square, Stripe), customers see more than one checkout button.  

Learn more about the:
  • PayPal express button
  • Apple Pay express button

Can customers add different types of items to the cart (store products, bookings services, restaurant items)?

The Cart Icon, Cart Page, and Side Cart can be used with the following business solutions:
  • Wix Stores
  • Wix Bookings
  • Wix Restaurants Orders (New)

Customers can add one or more store products and bookings services to the cart and complete checkout for them at the same time. 

Note: Wix Restaurants menu items cannot currently be purchased as part of the same order as store products or bookings services.

How can my Wix Stores customers go straight to checkout, bypassing the Cart Icon and Cart Page altogether?

If you have the type of store where customers often purchase a single item, you may want to streamline the checkout process by allowing customers to bypass the Cart Icon, Side Cart (Mini Cart), and Cart Page. 

To do so, enable the Buy Now button on the Product Page. 
  1. Click the Product Page in your editor.
  2. Click Settings.
  3. Click the Settings tab.
  4. Scroll down and click the Show button toggle under Buy Now to enable it.

I use Wix Bookings. How can I enable the Side Cart, Cart Page, and Cart Icon?

  1. Go to Booking Settings in your site's dashboard.
  2. Click Cart checkout. 
  3. Enable the Active toggle to add the Side Cart (Mini Cart), Cart Page, and Cart Icon to your site.
    Tip: With the cart active, clients can book more than one session at a time and add store products to the same order.
  4. Click Save.

articles.title: Wix Editor: Adding and Setting Up a Video Mask
articles.html_content:
Give your VideoBox a unique shape and create a striking visual effect using video masks. Choose from thousands of shapes and vector art offered by Wix, or upload a shape of your own to cut out your video.

Step 1 | Add a VideoBox or a Video Mask

To get started, open the Add Elements panel and select a video from the VideoBox / Video Mask section. You can click More Videos to view hundreds of videos offered by Wix, or upload a video of your own.

To add a VideoBox:

  1. Go to your editor.
  2. Click Add Elements  on the left side of the editor.
  3. Click Video & Music.
  4. Add a video to your page in one of the following ways:
    • Drag a video to your page from the VideoBox/ Video Mask section.
    • Click More Videos to view more videos offered by Wix, or upload your own from the Media Manager. 
Tips:
  • The VideoBox and Video Mask suggestions in the Add Elements panel are fully customizable. You can change the video, choose a different mask, adjust the design and behavior as needed. 
  • You can also add a Video Mask directly to your site by clicking here.

Step 2 | Select a Mask for Your VideoBox

After adding a VideoBox, apply a mask to cut it into a cool shape. Choose one from the list or click the    icon to see more suggestions. Wix offers loads of shapes in different styles and themes, some are geometric (e.g., square, triangle, diamond) and others completely abstract.
In addition to the shapes, you can use any vector art illustration to mask your video, or even your own SVG file to give it a brand new look.

To add a mask to your VideoBox:

  1. Click your VideoBox in your editor.
  2. Click the Mask icon .
  3. Choose a shape for your VideoBox in one of the following ways:
    • Select a shape from the list. 
    • Click the Add icon  to view more shapes and vector art in the Media Manager. You can also upload your own SVG file from here. 
Need a different video?
Click your VideoBox and click Change Video to access the Media Manager. You can choose a free video offered by Wix or use a video from your site files.

Step 3 | Customize Your VideoBox

After masking your VideoBox, use the available settings to customize it further. Add shadow or a pattern overlay, pick a cover image and design the button that visitors click to play the video.
Next, manage the behaviors of your VideoBox so it achieves the desired effect. Choose how your video plays and stops, make it loop continuously and more.

To customize your VideoBox:

  1. Click the VideoBox in your editor.
  2. Do one of the following:
    • Click the Settings icon  to preview your video, replace it or reset the VideoBox to default settings. You can also add alt text to improve your site's SEO and accessibility. 
    • Click the Behaviors icon  to choose how your video starts (e.g., automatically, on click) and whether or not visitors can pause it. You can also enable sound and slo-mo when supported.
    • Click the Design icon  to choose a cover image, apply a pattern overlay and more.
    • Click the Big Play Button on your VideoBox to customize its design or choose a different button.
Note:
The Big Play Button appears on your live site only if you set your video to start when visitors click it.
Tip:
Certain videos offered by Wix were captured in slow motion. In those cases, you can choose whether to play them at normal speed or slo-mo using the Play in slo-mo toggle.

articles.title: Wix Media: Organizing the Files in Your Media Manager
articles.html_content:
Organizing your files helps you save time and stay efficient when looking for specific media. Keep your files in your Media Manager organized by sorting them into different folders and sub-folders, so you can avoid sifting through irrelevant files.
Make finding your files easier by narrowing your file search through filters, reordering your files, and adjusting the layout of your Media Manager. Use Boards to create account-level folders to easily access your media files across all your sites. 
In this article, learn more about:
  • Filtering files by file type
  • Creating a folder
  • Move a file to a folder
  • Save a file to your Boards
  • Renaming a file or folder
  • Frequently asked questions (FAQs)

Filtering files by file type

Filter your files by file types to find them more easily in the Media Manager. You can view your files in a list or gallery format and customize the order in which files are displayed.

To filter your files:

Wix Editor
Studio Editor
Wix app
  1. Go to the editor.
  2. Click Media  on the left side of the editor.
  3. Click Show More under Site Files.
  4. Find the files you need in the following ways:
    • Click the Media Types icon  below the search bar. Then, select the checkbox next to the relevant file type(s).
    • Click the Reorder list icon  to adjust how your files are displayed (Last Modified or Name):
      • Last Modified: Descending shows the files last worked on at the top of the list. Ascending shows your oldest modified files at the top of the list.
      • Name: Display your files in alphabetical order or from Z-A.
    • Click the Change layout icon  to switch between the Gallery and List view:
      • Gallery: Your media is displayed as thumbnails.
      • List: Your media is displayed in a list. 
  1. Go to the editor.
  2. Click Media  on the left side of the editor.
  3. Click Site Files on the left.
  4. Find the files you need in the following ways:
    • Click the Media Types icon  below the search bar. Then, select the checkbox next to the relevant file type(s).
    • Click the Reorder list icon  to adjust how your files are displayed (Last Modified or Name):
      • Last Modified: Descending shows the files last worked on at the top of the list. Ascending shows your oldest modified files at the top of the list.
      • Name: Display your files in alphabetical order or from Z-A.
    • Click the Change layout icon  to switch between the Gallery and List view:
      • Gallery: Your media is displayed as thumbnails.
      • List: Your media is displayed in a list. 
  1. Go to your site in the Wix app.
  2. Tap Manage  at the bottom.
  3. Scroll down and tap Settings. 
  4. Tap Media Manager.
  5. Tap Site media.
  6. Find the files you need in the following ways:
    • Tap Sort by: Newest and find the files you need in the following ways:
      • Choose how to sort the files: Newest, Oldest, File name: A-Z, or File name: Z-A.
      • Select the checkbox next to the relevant file type(s).
    • Tap the More Actions icon  to switch between the grid and list view:
      • Change to grid view: Your media is displayed as thumbnails.
      • Change to list view: Your media is displayed in a list.

Creating a folder

Organize your Media Manager into folders so that you can easily find what you are looking for.

To create a folder in your Media Manager:

Wix Editor
Studio Editor
Wix app
  1. Go to the editor.
  2. Click Media  on the left side of the editor.
  3. Click Show More under Site Files.
  4. Click Create New Folder.
  5. Type the name of the new folder.
  6. Press Enter on your keyboard.
  7. (Optional) Double-click the folder and click Create New Folder to create a sub-folder.
Tips:
  • Click Upload Media or drag files into the new folder to add media.
  • Hover over the folder and click the More Actions icon  to add the folder to your Favorites, rename it, copy it and more.

Tips:

Moving a file to a folder

After creating folders in your Media Manager, move files to the relevant folder for a clean and organized look.

To move a file to a folder in the Media Manager:

Wix Editor
Studio Editor
Wix app
  1. Go to the editor.
  2. Click Media  on the left side of the editor.
  3. Click Show More under Site Files.
  4. Hover over the relevant file and click the More Actions icon .

Saving a file to your Boards

Use Boards to create account-level folders to easily access your media files across all your sites.

To save a file to your Boards:

Wix Editor
Studio Editor
Wix app

  2. Click Media  on the left side of the editor.

Tip:
Click the Add to My Favorites Board icon to automatically add the file to the My Favorites folder.
  1. Go to your site in the Wix app.
  2. Tap Manage  at the bottom.
  3. Scroll down and tap Settings. 
  4. Tap Media Manager.
  5. Tap Site media.
  6. Tap the More Actions icon  under the relevant file.
  7. Scroll down and tap Add to a board.
  8. Tap the Board where you want to add your media or tap Create New Board.
Add multiple files to a Board:
Tap the More Actions icon at the top right, tap Select, and mark multiple files. Then tap the Add to a board icon  at the bottom and select the Board where you want to add your media.

Renaming a file or folder

You may want to change the name of your media files and folders to accurately reflect their content, so you can easily find them later on.

To rename a file or folder:

Wix Editor
Studio Editor
Wix app
  1. Go to the editor.
  2. Click Media  on the left side of the editor.
  3. Click Show More under Site Files.
  4. Hover over the relevant file or folder and click the More Actions icon .
  5. Click Rename.
  6. Type the file or folder's new name.
  7. Press Enter on your keyboard.
Tip:
Click the Add to My Favorites Board icon to automatically add the file to the My Favorites folder.
  1. Go to the editor.
  2. Click Media  on the left side of the editor.
  3. Click Site Files on the left.
  4. Hover over the relevant file or folder and click the More Actions icon .
  5. Click Rename.
  6. Type the file or folder's new name.
  7. Press Enter on your keyboard.
Tip:
Click the Add to My Favorites Board icon to automatically add the file to the My Favorites folder.
  1. Go to your site in the Wix app.
  2. Tap Manage  at the bottom.
  3. Scroll down and tap Settings. 
  4. Tap Media Manager.
  5. Tap Site media.
  6. Tap the More Actions icon  under the relevant file or folder.
  7. Tap Rename.
  8. Type the file or folder's new name.
  9. Tap Save.

FAQs

Click a question below to learn more about organizing your files in your Media Manager:

Can I sort my files by numerical order?

No. Currently, it is not possible to sort files, with names consisting of digits, in numerical order. 

The Media Manager sorts files by the first digit listed, meaning files are sorted as such: 1, 100, 11, 12, 13, 130... 20, 200, 21. 

If this is something you'd like to see in the future, vote for this feature.

Can I sort my files in a non-case-sensitive manner?

No. Currently, it is not possible to sort files in a non-case-sensitive manner in the Media Manager. Files whose names begin with a capital letter are listed first, followed by files whose names begin with a lower case letter. 

If this is something you'd like to see in the future, vote for this feature.

Can I download all folders in my Site Files at once?

No. Currently, it is not possible to select multiple files and folders at once from Site Files in the Media Manager in order to download all your media in zip format. 

Multiple files within each folder can be selected and downloaded together, but each folder must be opened individually in order to choose and download the selected media. 

If this is something you'd like to see in the future, vote for this feature.

question: Can I accept partial payments or deposits in Wix Stores?
answer: Currently, it's not possible to accept partial payments or deposits in Wix Stores. However, it's now possible to [accept partial payment for an unpaid order by manually entering credit card details](https://support.wix.com/en/article/accepting-payment-by-manually-entering-credit-card-details#accepting-partial-payment-for-an-order) (currently available if you accept payment through Wix Payments or Isracard). Note that you can also [manually create an order yourself](https://support.wix.com/en/article/manually-creating-an-order-8027377). Additionally, you can [let customers pay in installments](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-stores-letting-customers-pay-in-installments) by connecting certain payment methods.

question: How can I connect my Wix store to my Amazon seller account?
answer:
Prerequisites: Ensure you have an Amazon Sellers account set up.

To connect your Wix store to Amazon:

1. [Go to the Amazon tab](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Your%20Amazon%20Shop%20&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/store/amazon/?referralInfo=sidebar) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **Start Now**.
3. Select your Amazon marketplace from the **Where do you sell from?** drop-down.
4. Select **Yes, I have an existing account**.
5. Sign in to your Amazon sellers account.

articles.contents:
Wix Stores: Connecting and Setting Up an Amazon Shop
Important:Each Amazon account can connect to one Wix site. Expand your sales platform by connecting your Wix store to sell on Amazon. This article will walk you through how to connect your Wix store to Amazon, publish Wix products on Amazon and link any Amazon products you already have to Wix.Check available languages, locations, and Amazon marketplacesThe ability to connect to an Amazon shop is available for merchants in all locations, as long as your site is in one of the following languages:
English French German Spanish JapaneseThe following Amazon marketplaces are supported:
Australia Belgium Brazil Canada Egypt France Germany India Italy Japan Mexico Netherlands Poland Saudi Arabia Singapore Spain Sweden United Kingdom United StatesNote:You can also fulfill orders using the Amazon Multi-Channel Fulfillment app.Selling products from AmazonAmazon offers 2 ways to add products to your store:
Match your product to an existing Amazon product: Amazon has a catalog of existing products and product variants. You can sell on Amazon if you successfully find a match. Note that many brand-name products do not appear in the catalog.  Create a new product: You can go through the process of submitting your own product for sale on Amazon. Note that Amazon may not authorize all products.
Step 1 | Create your Amazon Sellers AccountTo sell on Amazon, you need to have an Amazon Sellers account. During setup, you can select any of the supported marketplaces.Learn more about global selling and  set up an Amazon Sellers accountStep 2 | Connect your Wix store to AmazonConnect your Wix Store to your Amazon seller account. When you're done, you'll see all of your products from each marketplace listed in the Amazon tab in your Wix dashboard. Later, you can decide which Wix products you want to sell on Amazon and which of your Amazon products you want to sell in your Wix store. To connect to Amazon:
Go to the Amazon tab in your site's dashboard. Click Start Now. Select your Amazon marketplace from the Where do you sell from? drop-down. Select Yes, I have an existing account. Sign in to your Amazon sellers account.Step 3 | Choose your default Amazon shop settingsManage how inventory is restocked in your Amazon shop, how Amazon orders are fulfilled, and more. To choose default Amazon shop settings:
Go to the Amazon tab in your site's dashboard. Click the Settings iconat the top right. Click the Inventory Sync tab. (Optional) Set limits for how many of each product variant you sync with Amazon.
Note: This doesn't affect store inventory for Wix store variants. It just limits the amount of inventory shared with Amazon. For example, when quantity goes down to 10, reset it to 100. 
    
Click the Limit variant quantity to enable it. Enter the maximum quantity.   (Optional) Enable automatic restocking in Amazon (recommended):
Note: When a product’s inventory is set to “In Stock” in the Wix dashboard and you choose to automatically restock, it’ll display 1 item in stock.
    
Click the Automatically restock Amazon inventory to enable it. Under When quantity reaches, enter a minimum inventory amount. When stock quantity goes down to this amount, your Amazon store is automatically restocked. Under Restock quantity to, enter a restock quantity level. When the minimum inventory amount (set in step 5b) is reached, stock automatically resets to this quantity.    Set what happens when a Wix product is unavailable: Select the checkbox next to an option to remove a product from your Amazon store when:
    
You delete a product: When you delete a product from your Wix dashboard, it is removed from your Amazon store. You hide a product: When you hide a product from your Wix dashboard, it is removed from your Amazon store. If you unhide it, the product appears in the Amazon tab under Unpublished products and you can republish it.  A product is out of stock (Relevant for products for which inventory is not tracked): When you manually set a product to the "Out of stock" setting, it is removed from your Amazon store. If you change the status back to "In stock", the product appears in the Amazon tab under Unpublished products and you can republish it.    Select a default fulfillment option from the Fulfilled by drop-down:
Note: You can override this option per product.

articles.title: Wix Stores: Connecting and Setting Up an Amazon Shop
articles.html_content:
Important:
Each Amazon account can connect to one Wix site. 
Expand your sales platform by connecting your Wix store to sell on Amazon. 
This article will walk you through how to connect your Wix store to Amazon, publish Wix products on Amazon and link any Amazon products you already have to Wix.

Check available languages, locations, and Amazon marketplaces

The ability to connect to an Amazon shop is available for merchants in all locations, as long as your site is in one of the following languages:
  • English
  • French
  • German
  • Spanish
  • Japanese

The following Amazon marketplaces are supported:
  • Australia
  • Belgium
  • Brazil
  • Canada
  • Egypt
  • France
  • Germany
  • India
  • Italy
  • Japan
  • Mexico
  • Netherlands
  • Poland
  • Saudi Arabia
  • Singapore
  • Spain
  • Sweden
  • United Kingdom
  • United States
Note:
You can also fulfill orders using the Amazon Multi-Channel Fulfillment app.

Selling products from Amazon

Amazon offers 2 ways to add products to your store:
  • Match your product to an existing Amazon product: Amazon has a catalog of existing products and product variants. You can sell on Amazon if you successfully find a match. Note that many brand-name products do not appear in the catalog. 
  • Create a new product: You can go through the process of submitting your own product for sale on Amazon. Note that Amazon may not authorize all products.

Step 1 | Create your Amazon Sellers Account

To sell on Amazon, you need to have an Amazon Sellers account. During setup, you can select any of the supported marketplaces.
Learn more about global selling and  set up an Amazon Sellers account

Step 2 | Connect your Wix store to Amazon

Connect your Wix Store to your Amazon seller account. When you're done, you'll see all of your products from each marketplace listed in the Amazon tab in your Wix dashboard. Later, you can decide which Wix products you want to sell on Amazon and which of your Amazon products you want to sell in your Wix store. 

To connect to Amazon:

  1. Go to the Amazon tab in your site's dashboard.
  2. Click Start Now.
  3. Select your Amazon marketplace from the Where do you sell from? drop-down.
  4. Select Yes, I have an existing account.
  5. Sign in to your Amazon sellers account.

Step 3 | Choose your default Amazon shop settings

Manage how inventory is restocked in your Amazon shop, how Amazon orders are fulfilled, and more. 

To choose default Amazon shop settings:

  1. Go to the Amazon tab in your site's dashboard.
  2. Click the Settings iconat the top right.
  3. Click the Inventory Sync tab.
  4. (Optional) Set limits for how many of each product variant you sync with Amazon.
    Note: This doesn't affect store inventory for Wix store variants. It just limits the amount of inventory shared with Amazon. For example, when quantity goes down to 10, reset it to 100. 
    1. Click the Limit variant quantity to enable it.
    2. Enter the maximum quantity.
  5. (Optional) Enable automatic restocking in Amazon (recommended):
    Note: When a product’s inventory is set to “In Stock” in the Wix dashboard and you choose to automatically restock, it’ll display 1 item in stock.
    1. Click the to enable it.
    2. Under When quantity reaches, enter a minimum inventory amount. When stock quantity goes down to this amount, your Amazon store is automatically restocked.
    3. Under Restock quantity to, enter a restock quantity level. When the minimum inventory amount (set in step 5b) is reached, stock automatically resets to this quantity. 
  6. Set what happens when a Wix product is unavailable: Select the checkbox next to an option to remove a product from your Amazon store when:
    • You delete a product: When you delete a product from your Wix dashboard, it is removed from your Amazon store.
    • You hide a product: When you hide a product from your Wix dashboard, it is removed from your Amazon store. If you unhide it, the product appears in the Amazon tab under Unpublished products and you can republish it. 
    • A product is out of stock (Relevant for products for which inventory is not tracked): When you manually set a product to the "Out of stock" setting, it is removed from your Amazon store. If you change the status back to "In stock", the product appears in the Amazon tab under Unpublished products and you can republish it. 
  7. Select a default fulfillment option from the Fulfilled by drop-down:
    Note: You can override this option per product. 
    • Amazon: 
      1. Select a time from the Delivery time drop-down.
      2. Go to Amazon to set up Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA).
    • Self fulfilled: Choose how many business days it takes before you ship. 

Step 4 | Offer Wix Stores products on Amazon

To sell a product on Amazon, you must first find and match the product in your Wix store to the corresponding product in Amazon's catalog of existing products.

If the product has variants, you can match each variant to the matching Amazon variant - provided they exist in the Amazon product catalog.
Note:
Many brand-name products do not appear in the catalog.

To offer Wix Stores products on Amazon:

  1. Click Unpublished to view only products not on sale in Amazon.
  1. Select a product.
  2. If the product has variants, click to select a variant. 
  3. Click Find Product.
    Tip: If you want to create a new listing rather than matching an existing product, click Create new Amazon listing to start the process.
  4. Enter a product name or identifier.
    Note: You can enter different types of product IDs such as UPC, EAN, ISBN, or ASIN numbers to locate the product. 
  5. (Optional) Click Filter by category and select a category to filter your search. 
  6. (Optional) Click View product listing to make sure you've selected the correct product. 
  7. Select the product.
  1. Click Select.
    Note: When you're done, you'll see the matched products: The Wix product on top and the matched Amazon product below. 
  2. (Optional) Enable the Customize for Amazon toggle to customize the product:
    • Enter a price.
      Note: This is the price it sells for on Amazon. 
    • Offer the product at a sale price:
      1. Enable the On sale toggle
      2. Enter the sale price. 
    • Enter an inventory quantity for Amazon.
    • Enter the maximum number of this product that can be purchased in one order.
    • Select an option from the Condition drop-down.
    • Select who packs and ships this product from the Fulfilled by drop-down:
      • Amazon (FBA):
        1. Select a time from the Delivery time drop-down.
        2. If you have not yet done so, go to Amazon to set up Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA).
      • Self fulfilled: Choose how many business days it takes before you ship.
    • Select the Offer gift wrapping checkbox.
      Note: Amazon may charge for giftwrapping if you selected Amazon as the fulfiller.
    • Select the Offer gift messaging checkbox to let customers add a message to gifts.
      Note: Amazon may charge for allowing gift messages if you selected Amazon as the fulfiller.
  3. Do any of the following:
    • Preview your product on Amazon: Click the More Actions icon   at the top and click View store product.
    • Save your changes but don't publish: Click the More Actions icon   at the top and click Save Changes as Draft.
    • Click Save & Publish at the top to list (offer) your product on Amazon (may take a few minutes). 
Note:
Products must be published one at a time.

Step 5 | Link existing Amazon products to your Wix store

If you've been selling on Amazon, and you now want to manage your Wix and Amazon stores in one place, you can link the products. 
Before you begin:
To link products, the product must exist in your Wix account. If it does not yet exist, create it before you begin. 
In the Amazon tab, the Unlinked to Wix products are your live Amazon products that are not connected to a product in your Wix store. 

To link existing Amazon product to Wix:

  1. Click Unlinked to Wix at the top.
  2. Select a product.
  3. Click Choose Product.
  4. Select the Wix product you want to link to.
  5. Click Save & Update.

FAQs

Can I sell digital products on Amazon?

Digital products cannot be listed on Amazon. You won't see them in the Amazon tab in your site's dashboard.

Can a product that's hidden be sold on Amazon?

Products that are hidden from your Wix site cannot be listed on Amazon and do not appear in the Amazon tab in your site's dashboard.

Can I allow customers to pre-order products that are currently out of stock?

Yes. By adding a restock date you can allow customers to order out-of-stock products. You can ship them as soon as they are back in stock. 

To display a restock date:
  1. Go to the Amazon tab in your site's dashboard.
  2. Select an out-of-stock product.
    Note: The product must be have a published, unpublished, or unsuccessful status.
  3. (For products with variants) Select a variant.
  4. Click the Customize for Amazon toggle to enable it.
  5. Click the Restock Date field and select a date.
Want to learn more?
Check out the full course in Wix Learn on building your store or skip to the video on selling on Amazon.

question: How can I change the size of the menu icon on my Wix mobile site?

1. Click the menu icon in the [mobile Editor](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-accessing-the-mobile-editor).

articles.html_content:
Menus that you have added to your desktop site are automatically added to your mobile site. 
You can adjust the size of the menu to suit smaller screen sizes, as well adjust the alignment of the text to fit your mobile site's layout.
In this article, learn more about:
  • Adjusting the size of your menu
  • Changing your menu's alignment

Changing the size of your mobile menu

Make the menu larger or smaller to fit your site, and make sure it looks good on mobile devices.
You can change the size of the menu icon, as well as the size of the opened menu by using the drag handles. 

To change the size of your mobile menu:

  1. Click the menu icon in the mobile editor.
  2. Choose what you want to do:

Change the size of the menu icon

Click and drag the resize handles to increase or decrease the size of the menu.

Change the size of the open menu

  1. Click Edit Menu.
  2. Click the menu text.
  3. Click and drag the resize handles to increase or decrease the size of the menu.

Changing your menu alignment

Change the alignment of both the item text, and the submenu arrows on your mobile site. 

To change the alignment of your mobile menu:

  1. Click the mobile menu in the mobile Editor.
  2. Click Edit Menu.
  3. Click the mobile menu text.
  4. Click the Layout icon .
  5. Choose what you want to do: 

Change the alignment of the menu text

Select an alignment under How's text aligned?:
  • Left: The menu items are aligned to the left.
  • Center: The menu items are aligned to the center.
  • Right: The menu items are aligned to the right.

Change the alignment of submenu arrows

Choose an alignment under How's the submenu arrow aligned?:
  • Left: The arrow is displayed to the left of the item text.
  • Right: The arrow is displayed to the right of the item text.

What's next?
Customize your mobile menu's design to suit your site and encourage your visitors to explore.

question: How can I offer different prices for services based on the staff member's expertise in Wix Bookings?
answer: You can create pricing options for appointments based on the staff member in charge of the service. This is a great way to offer clients more flexible pricing options to suit their needs. It also allows your more experienced staff to focus on high value clients.

articles.contents:
Wix Bookings: Understanding Price Options
Price options allow you to charge for your services based on different factors. You can create custom price options for each service to suit your business, your staff, and your clients.Show me Price option examples:Below are some examples of how you can use price options to offer more flexible pricing for your clients. Offer different price options based on:

The type of participant booking the session: Offer different price options for adults, children, students and senior citizens. The type of a particular service the client wants to book: Offer different different prices for different types or durations of massage, for example. The staff member providing the service: Allow clients to book services based on the staff member and set different prices for each staff member, if required. The location of the service: Offer discounts to encourage clients to book at your new location, for example. The time or date of the service: Give clients discounted rates during off-peak hours, for example. The number of participants: Allow clients to make group bookings at different rates, with price breaks for larger groups. Important:Please note that your clients won't be able to reschedule sessions paid with price options.Offer different prices based on staff members' expertiseYou can create pricing options for appointments based on the staff member in charge of the service. This is a great way to offer clients more flexible pricing options to suit their needs. It also allows your more experienced staff to focus on high value clients.Create custom pricing optionsYou can also offer different custom pricing options depending on your needs. For example, you can charge different rates for ski lessons during the off season and during the high season. Or you can offer discounted rates to students and senior citizens. Learn how to add price options to your services:
Appointments Classes Courses

question: How can I connect the Triple-A Crypto Payment Gateway as a payment provider on my Wix site?
answer:
To connect the Triple-A Crypto Payment Gateway as a payment provider on your Wix site, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Accept Payments](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Set%20Up%20Payments&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7b%7bmetaSiteId%7d%7d/payments/) in your site's dashboard.

   **Tip:** Check your business location at the top right. If incorrect, click the drop-down menu to change it.

2. Click **See More Payment Options**.
3. Click **Connect** next to Triple-A Crypto Payment Gateway.
4. Depending on whether you are creating a new Triple-A account or have an existing account, follow the instructions:

   **Have an account**
   1. Enter your Client ID and Client Secret.
   2. Click **Connect**.

   1. Click [**Create Triple-A Payment Gateway account**](https://triple-a.io/signup/).
   2. Register for a Triple-A account.
   3. Wait for an email from Triple-A to get your Client ID and Client Secret credentials.
   4. Return to the Accept Payments tab (repeat steps 1-4) and follow the steps under **Have an account** to connect your account.

articles.title: Connecting Triple-A Crypto Payment Gateway as a Payment Provider
articles.html_content:
Accept cryptocurrency payments from your customers using Triple-A Payment Gateway as your payment provider.
General Info
 
Supported countries
Australia, Brazil, Canada, Singapore, United Kingdom and United States
Supported cryptocurrencies
Bitcoin (BTC), Bitcoin Lightning (LBTC), Ethereum (ETH), USDT Tether (USDT)
Account activation time
Immediate
Notes
The currency used in your Wix account must match the currency in your Triple-A account. If the currencies do not match, the transactions may be declined. Learn how to change your currency.
Managing your account
For information on topics such as payout schedules, refunding a customer, chargeback disputes, and more, contact Triple-A
In this article, learn about:
  • Connecting Triple-A
  • Frequently asked questions (FAQs)

Connecting Triple-A

  1. Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard.
    Tip: Check your business location at the top right. If incorrect, click the drop-down menu to change it.
  2. Click See More Payment Options.
  3. Click Connect next to Triple-A.
  1. Depending on whether you are creating a new Triple-A account or have an existing account, follow the instructions:

Have an account

  1. Enter your Client ID and Client Secret.
  2. Click Connect.

Don't have an account

  1. Click Create Triple-A Payment Gateway account.
  2. Register for a Triple-A account.
  3. Wait for an email from Triple-A to get your Client ID and Client Secret credentials. 
  4. Return to the Accept Payments tab (repeat steps 1-4) and follow the steps under Have an account to connect your account.

FAQs

Click a question below to learn more about accepting payments.

Can I connect more than 1 payment provider?

Yes. You can connect different payment providers to support different payment methods. If you wish to use another payment provider for credit card transactions, you can connect Triple-A as a payment provider for cryptocurrency transactions only.

How can I tell if a payment method is active?

In order to accept online payments, you must connect a payment provider. 
Once connected, your checkout will be active for your chosen payment method(s).

You need to have your account successfully verified to receive payouts.

Is my currency supported?

Be aware that payments will fail If you are using an unsupported currency.
The currency used in your payment provider account must match the currency that you set in your Wix account. If you need to change the currency set in your provider account, please contact your payment provider.

If your current payment provider does not support your desired currency, Wix hosts a wide range of alternative payment providers. Learn how to change your payment provider.

What is a minimum payment amount?

Some payment providers have a minimum payment threshold (e.g. $1.01). Payments below this amount will not be processed.

Make sure that all of your products or services are priced over the minimum threshold. This includes discounted items or Pricing Plans. 

Please contact your payment provider to get the most up-to-date information about their minimum payment threshold. 

Can I offer recurring payments?

To offer recurring payments, you must connect a payment provider that supports recurring payments.

How do I get my payouts?

Payouts are managed by your payment provider. If your provider is a third-party provider, contact them directly.
If your provider is Wix Payments, learn about receiving payouts from Wix Payments. 

My customers' payments are being declined. What can I do?

If your customers are experiencing payment failures, you may be able to fix the issue by troubleshooting issues for accepting payments.

Why can’t I connect my desired payment provider?

If you’re having trouble connecting your payment provider, you may be able to fix the issue by troubleshooting common connection issues.

question: How can I hyperlink text to dynamic pages using the Wix Editor?
answer:
To hyperlink text to dynamic pages using the Wix Editor, follow these steps:

1. [Go to your editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26).
2. Click the relevant text element and click **Edit Text**.
3. Highlight the specific text you want to link.
4. Click the **Link** icon ![](https://d2eyqiy4n03ve6.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/2015/08/03/763a7510-465e-4098-928d-83e534a9f4a4.png).
5. Click the **Which page?** drop-down and select the relevant page under **Dynamic pages**.

**Tip:** Your editor names dynamic list pages as **{Collection name} (List)** and dynamic item pages as **{Collection name} (Item)**.
6. (Dynamic item pages only) Click the **Which item?** drop-down and choose the item you want to link to.
7. (Optional) Set [rel link attributes](https://support.wix.com/en/article/adding-link-rel-attributes) to give search engines more info about the link(s):
   
   1. Click **Advanced SEO Settings**.
   2. Click the drop-down and choose which rel values the links should have:
      
      * **noopener (recommended):** Block access to the source page.
      * **noreferrer (recommended):** Hide info about link source.
      * **nofollow:** Tell search engines to ignore.
      * **sponsored:** Mark the link as sponsored.

8. Click **Done**.

**Tip:** To link to a section or anchor on your dynamic page, after step 4 above, select **Section or anchor**. Then follow steps 5-6 and select the section or anchor from the **Where on the page?** drop-down.

Link a button or image to a dataset that connects to this URL field. Table

Repeater

Make sure your repeater contains a button or image element, then connect the relevant element.

Linking navigational buttons in dynamic item pages

Create navigational buttons that, when clicked, take visitors to the next or previous item in the dynamic item page. You can also create buttons that link back to the collection's dynamic list page.

The next or previous item that loads is determined by the dataset's filters and sort conditions. If you're using the Control item visibility setting, hidden items are not read by the dataset so their dynamic item pages do not load. 
Wix Editor
Studio Editor
  1. Go to the dynamic item page in your editor where you want to link a button or image to the next/previous dynamic page. 
  2. Click the relevant button or image.
  3. Click the Connect to CMS icon .
  4. Click the Choose a dataset drop-down and select an existing dataset that connects to your collection. 
  5. Click the Click action connects to drop-down or the Link connects to drop-down and choose the relevant option:
    • Next dynamic page: Navigate to the next dynamic item page returned by the dataset. 
    • Previous dynamic page: Navigate to the previous dynamic item page returned by the dataset. 
    • {Collection name} (List): Navigate back to your collection's dynamic list page.
  6. Under How does it open?, choose how the link opens: In the current window or As a new window. 
  7. (Optional for buttons) Click the Label connects to drop-down and select a field to use it as dynamic text that changes depending on the next/previous dynamic item page.
    Tip: Alternatively, you can use static text on the button by clicking the button and selecting Change Text.

    Tip: Alternatively, you can use static text on the button by clicking the button and selecting Change Text. 

FAQs

Click below for answers to common questions about linking to dynamic pages. 

What is a dynamic page?

Dynamic pages are used to display content from a CMS (Content Management System) collection. They allow you to create websites that can efficiently handle a large amount of content while maintaining a consistent design and user experience. 

There are two types of dynamic pages in Wix; dynamic list pages, and dynamic item pages. Dynamic list pages display multiple collection items in a repeater, gallery or table. The items in your repeater, gallery, or table link to a single dynamic item page that provides more details about a particular item. Each item gets its own "version" of the same dynamic item page with a unique URL ending. 

Learn more about working with dynamic pages in Wix. 

How are the URLs for my dynamic item pages created?

By default, the URLs of your dynamic item pages end with the collection name, followed by the primary field in the collection (for example, /properties/luxury-villa-with-a-view). You can view the URLs for each item, as well as for your dynamic list pages in the Page Link field type of your collection. 


Go to the SEO tab of your page settings to add variables to the URL slug of your dynamic pages. 

What are dynamic URLs?

Dynamic URLs are webpage addresses that change based on the page's connected collection. Each item in your collection needs a unique dynamic page URL for the dynamic page to exist. This is why you may need to add fields to the URL to give each item in your collection its own unique URL. 

Learn more about creating unique dynamic page URLs.

What is a dataset?


Datasets are the vital link between the elements on your page and the content in your CMS collection. You can use datasets to create a two-way connection, allowing you to display collection content, capture user inputs, or both. 

Datasets allow you to control which parts of your page elements connect to which fields in your collection. Each dataset connects to a collection and each element connected to the dataset connects to a field in the collection. This unlocks a new way of managing which content appears and where.

Learn more about adding and setting up a dataset. 

Can I create a dynamic link that visitors click to send emails?

Yes. You can create dynamic links that open the visitor's mail client so they can send an email to the relevant address.

To create dynamic links that open the visitor's mail client: 
  1. Create a URL field type in your collection for storing the email addresses. 
  2. Add the email addresses to the field with mailto: at the beginning of each address (e.g. mailto:support@email.com).
  3. Link a button or image to a dataset that connects to this URL field. When visitors click the link, their email client opens with the relevant address in the 'To:' field.

Learn more about linking buttons to CMS collection fields in datasets.

articles.html_content:
Add a site title to the top of your page to give your visitors a clear idea of what you, your site, or your brand is all about. Titles are a great way to grab your visitors' attention, and get them interested in exploring your site. 
In this article, learn more about:
  • Adding a site title
  • How site titles can improve your site

Adding a site title

Site titles should be placed at the top of your site and have a larger font than the rest of the text found on your home page. This ensures that your visitors can clearly see it when they enter your site.
Note:
Adding a site title to your header means that it will appear on all pages.

Show me how

  1. Click Add Elements on the left of the Editor.
  2. Click Text.
  3. Click Titles.
  4. Click and drag the text you want to use onto the top of your page or onto your header.
  5. Click the text in your Editor.
  6. Click Edit Text.
  7. Enter your site's title.
Tip:
Learn how to format your text to suit the look and feel of your site. 

Improving your site with titles

Having a site title can enhance many aspects of your site, such as SEO and accessibility.
As well as enhancing your site, it can also improve your visitors' experience by proving a clear summary of your site.  
Click below to learn more about the benefits of having a clear site title.

SEO benefits

Having a clear site title that matches your URL means that when Google indexes your site, your site title will show up along with your web address.
We recommend adding your site title as text, and making sure it's the same name as it is within your site's dashboard settings to ensure that Google indexes it correctly. Learn how to change your site's name on your dashboard

Accessibility benefits

Having a clear site title can help visitors with disabilities or impairments understand what your site is about. 
We recommend adding your site title as text, as well as defining the heading tags. This ensures that visitors using screen readers can navigate your site with ease. Learn how to define your text headings

Add unique title tags to each of your pages to enhance your site's SEO and Accessiblity. Learn how to add title tags to your site pages

question: How can I export my contacts from my Wix site?
answer:
To export your contacts from your Wix site, follow these steps:

1. Go to [Contacts](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Contacts&title=Select%20a%20site%20to%20update&actionUrl=https:%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Fmy-account%2Fsites%2F%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D%2Fcontacts%2F) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click the **Import / Export** drop-down and select **Export contacts**.

   If you want to export specific contacts, select the checkboxes next to the relevant contact(s) in your contact list before completing Step 2.

3. Choose the contacts to export:
   * **Selected Contacts:** Exports only the contacts selected from the contact list.
   * **By Label:** Click the drop-down menu to select a contact group, or select **All Contacts**.
4. Select the relevant file format:
   * Regular CSV file
   * Google CSV file
   * Outlook CSV file
5. Click **Export**.
6. Save the file to your computer.
