question: How can I customize the outer background of my email campaign in Wix?
answer:
To customize the outer background of your email campaign in Wix, follow these steps:

1. Go to [Email Marketing](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Email%20Marketing%20Dashboard&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/shoutout/) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **Edit** next to an existing campaign or [create a new one](https://support.wix.com/en/article/email-marketing-creating-a-new-campaign).
3. Click **Background** on the left.
4. Choose whether to show background colors or patterns and images in the outer background:
   
   * **Background colors:** Select the relevant color or click the Pick Color icon to choose a custom color.
   * **Patterns and images:** Select the relevant pattern/image or click the Add icon to choose another pattern or image. Then click the Settings icon to choose the color behind the image or to have the image repeat itself across the background.

The recommended image size is 1920 X 1080 pixels, but the background width is limited to 720 pixels when viewed as an email. We suggest using decorative images for the background. If a subscriber clicks to view the full email, they will see the complete background.

question: How can I access and customize my sales reports in Wix Analytics?
answer:
To access your sales reports in Wix Analytics, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Reports](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?title=Select%20a%20Site&buttonText=Analytics%20Reports&actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fmanage.wix.com%2Fdashboard%2F%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D%2Fanalytics/reports/?referralInfo=sidebar) in your site's dashboard.
2. View the reports in the **Sales** section.

To customize your sales reports, you can adjust the data you're viewing and the way it's displayed. You can also save the views you want to return to later. Learn more about [customizing your report](https://support.wix.com/en/article/customizing-wix-analytics-reports).

articles.contents:

Compare the performance of item sales over different time periods.Sales by couponThe sales by coupon report shows you how many times your coupons have been used and how coupons are affecting sales.Use this report to:

See where coupon users are located geographically.Tip: Use coupon trends to determine if a promotion should be repeated or stop promotions that aren't delivering results.Sales by billing locationThe sales by billing location report shows you where your customers are located.Use this report to:

A variant is an item with unique product options, such as color and size.Use this report to:

Discover which product variants are not selling as well as others.Tip: Run an email marketing or paid ad campaign to promote a product that isn't selling as well or promote some products with seasonal campaigns.Clients with overdue paymentsThe clients with overdue payments report is useful for business owners who receive payments before or after providing services, such as training sessions or dance classes.Use this report to:

articles.title: Wix Analytics: About Your Sales Reports
articles.html_content:
Your sales reports by Wix Analytics help you to analyze all the payments that go through your site. All your sales data is translated into customizable reports to help you better understand what and how people are purchasing. You can view reports for sales by specific item, billing location, sales over time and more. 
You can use your sales reports to plan your business strategy, make educated predictions about sales trends, and to get a better understanding of how your visitors are making purchases on your site.
In this article, learn more about:
  • The types of sales reports
  • Frequently asked questions (FAQs)
How to access your sales reports:
Go to All Reports in your site's dashboard and view the reports in the Sales section. You can also check out the Sales Overview to get a deeper understanding of your customers' spending trends.

Types of sales reports

Wix Analytics creates sales reports for just about everything you want to know. See a breakdown of your revenue based on sales by coupon, order type, billing location, or shipping method. You can also view reports that track sales over a specific time period.
Click a report type below to learn more about it.

Sales over time

Sales over time allows you to compare your sales trends over different time periods. You can also select a measure to view over time including order quantity, refunds, gross sales and more.

Use this report to:
  • Monitor your sales, orders, refunds and other key performance indicators.
  • See how your sales are performing now compared to previous time periods.
  • Understand trends over time in sales distribution.

Sales by item

Sales by item gives you a breakdown of the specific items and services you've sold.

Use this report to: 
  • View your sales data by orders, items, and customers and compare the info over time to identify trends.
  • Monitor total orders and item quantity over time.

Item sales over time

Item sales over time allows you to view a specific item's sales over the course of set time periods. 

Use this report to:
  • See gross sales trends filtered by individual item.
  • See the sales trend of a group of items.
  • Compare the performance of item sales over different time periods.

Sales by coupon

The sales by coupon report shows you how many times your coupons have been used and how coupons are affecting sales.

Use this report to:
  • Find out who is using your coupons and filter by new or returning customers.
  • See where coupon users are located geographically.

Tip: Use coupon trends to determine if a promotion should be repeated or stop promotions that aren't delivering results.

Sales by billing location

The sales by billing location report shows you where your customers are located.

Use this report to:
  • Filter sales by city, region, or country
  • Discover how a specific location is performing and if your actions have impacted your sales volumes.

Tip: Target locations with high sales volumes with email campaigns or paid ads. You can also offer promotions in locations where sales volumes are low.

Sales by order type

Sales by order type shows you how you generate revenue with any installed Wix apps.

Use this report to:
  • Find out which Wix apps (Wix Stores, Wix Bookings, Wix Events) are generating the most revenue on your site.
  • Filter by total order, items sold, refunds and more per Wix app.

Average order value over time

Average order value over time displays your average value of orders for any day, week, or month.

Use this report to:
  • Find out how much your customers spend on average on your site.
  • Monitor changes in average order value (e.g. when offering discounts).
  • Learn the value of your users and tailor marketing campaigns for positive Return On Investment (ROI).

Sales by shipping method

Sales by shipping method shows you which shipping methods are most popular with your customers who purchase through Wix Stores.

Use this report to:
  • Learn which shipping methods have the most orders.
  • Calculate shipping costs vs. how much you charge for shipping.
  • Find out how much the cost of shipping impacts the shipping methods chosen by your customers.

Sales by product variant

The sales by product variant report shows which variants of your items are your best sellers. A variant is an item with unique product options, such as color and size.

Use this report to:
  • See which product variants are selling the most.
  • Discover which product variants are not selling as well as others.

Tip: Run an email marketing or paid ad campaign to promote a product that isn't selling as well or promote some products with seasonal campaigns.

Clients with overdue payments

The clients with overdue payments report is useful for business owners who receive payments before or after providing services, such as training sessions or dance classes.

Use this report to:
  • See which clients owe you money.
  • Find out which payments are overdue.
Want to customize your report?
You can customize the data you're viewing and the way it's displayed. You can also save the views you want to return to later. Learn more about customizing your report.

FAQs

Click a question below to learn more about your Wix Analytics sales reports.

What is the difference between my sales and stores reports?

Sales reports refer to all purchases made throughout your site. This includes all bookings, services, coaching, consultations and more. Wix Stores reports focus on purchases and transactions made if you have an online store.

Where can I learn about the terminology used in these reports?

Sales reports include a glossary that defines the terms used. To view these definitions, select a report and click Show report definitions under the report name.


Learn more about the Wix Analytics glossary.

How do I save my favorite reports so that I can access them quickly?

On the All Reports page, click the Add to Saved reports icon  next to a specific report to add it to your saved reports. Your saved reports appear at the top of the page.

How do I change the type of graph in the report?

On the All Reports page, hover over a report to see the different views available. The offered graphs vary according to the type of report (e.g. tables, line charts, maps).

You could also switch between report views within a report by clicking the options at the top.

Why can't I see data for redeemed coupons in the Sales by Coupon report?

If you do not see coupon sales in the Sales by Coupon report, it could be for two reasons:
  • Coupon sales data is currently only available for these Wix apps: Wix Stores, Wix Bookings, Wix Pricing Plans, Wix Events, and the Wix Ecommerce platform. Data is not available for apps such as Wix Restaurants, Online Programs, Invoices, or other business apps.
  • If one of your coupons grants a 100% discount for a Wix Bookings order, then the transaction equals 0. Therefore, this coupon usage will not be counted or displayed in the Sales by Coupon report.

Note: These reasons are also why you may see coupon data listed as 'Unknown' in the Sales over Time report.

Why are some store orders showing “Unknown” under the billing location?

If a store order was made with POS (Point of Sale), it won't show the location information. In general, it is currently not possible to get location information for orders with POS transactions.
The only case in which location data can appear in your report is when the location information is populated from the checkout page in Wix Stores.

question: How do I connect Agoda with my Wix Hotels by HotelRunner account?
answer:
### Prerequisites
- Ensure all room rates and availability are set on the Wix Hotels by HotelRunner dashboard.
- Update your rooms with 2 weeks of rates and availability for the channel manager to fully register your rooms.

### Steps to Connect Agoda with Wix Hotels by HotelRunner:
1. Go to [Channel Manager](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Fdashboard%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%2Fapp%2F826670ba-3a6b-4157-ac72-7c4fca9ce220%2F1a6e0874-2039-49cf-bef3-9138bb5c3b16%7C4%3F&title=Select+a+site&primaryButtonText=Open+Channel+Manager) in the Wix Hotels by HotelRunner dashboard.
2. Click **Connect** next to Agoda.
3. Click **Connect with** Agoda.
4. [Log in to the Agoda extranet](https://ycs.agoda.com) with your username and password.
   - **Note:** Please log in using the main host login information. Ensure no other Agoda account is open in your browser during this process.
5. Click **Settings** at the top.
6. Click **Property Settings**.
7. Click **Optional Settings**.
8. Select the **Enable channel manager** **mode** checkbox and choose HotelRunner from the drop-down.
9. Click **Save**.

articles.contents:

Agoda integrates with Wix Hotels by HotelRunner to streamline your booking management. After connection, HotelRunner will transfer all of your inventory to Agoda, overwriting the calendar you have on the channel and all updates must be done from Wix, your extranet calendar will be blocked. Once your Agoda connection is complete, the reservations you already had on Agoda and the new ones you will receive will be forwarded to Wix Hotels by HotelRunner. You can view all your reservations from the Reservations section. Before the integration, to open your slots on Agoda, please update your rooms with 2 weeks of rates and availability for the channel manager to fully register your rooms. Ensure that the extra beds in the Agoda extranet are reset and included in the number of adults to match the panel's total number of people, as this prevents errors. If you have blocked certain dates on your calendar before the integration, once the integration is completed, we cannot overwrite your blocked dates. To manage your calendar, unblock your calendar from the Agoda extranet.Step 2 | Approve Wix Hotels by HotelRunner for connection on AgodaTo connect Agoda with your Wix Hotels by HotelRunner account, navigate to the Channel Manager in your Wix dashboard and click "Connect" next to Agoda. Log in to the Agoda extranet, go to Property Settings, enable the Channel Manager option by selecting HotelRunner from the drop-down, and click "Save."Note:For further assistance, visit the Agoda help center. To approve Wix Hotels by HotelRunner for connection with Agoda:
Go to Channel Manager in the Wix Hotels by HotelRunner dashboard. Click Connect next to Agoda.  Click Connect with Agoda.  Log in to the Agoda extranet.
Note: Make sure to log in to Agoda using the main host login information. You should not have another Agoda account open in your browser during this process because it will automatically connect to that account. Click Settings at the top. Click Property Settings.  Click Optional Settings.  Select the Enable channel manager mode checkbox and choose HotelRunner from the drop-down.  Click Save. Step 3 | Map your room types on AgodaTo map room types, find your room IDs on the Agoda extranet in Rooms under Property, and then input these IDs in the 'Room type' mapping section of the Wix Hotels by HotelRunner dashboard. Agoda automatically sends your rooms to Wix Hotels by HotelRunner with their custom names. For this reason, you can use room IDs to distinguish your rooms from each other. Room IDs appear in the bottom right of the Wix Hotels by HotelRunner.  Make sure to match room availability and prices. You can then use the advanced settings feature to further adjust prices. Click "Complete mapping" once all room types and rates are set.Important:
In the channels where you see the HotelRunner standard rate, it should always be selected as “Main Rate” and “Don't Send”. The Agoda extranet currency and the selected currency on the mapping page must be the same.To map your room types:
Collect your room IDs on the Agoda extranet in Rooms under Property. In another tab on your browser, go to Channel Manager in the Wix Hotels by HotelRunner dashboard.  Click View channel details next to Agoda. Click Fetch room types.  Hover over each room type and click Expand.  Match your Agoda room types with your room types on Wix Hotels by HotelRunner using the drop-downs.
Note: Make sure to double-check you are matching the correct room types across both platforms, as there may be differences in room type names.  Click Save at the bottom. Step 4 | Adjust your advanced settingsWith the advanced settings for the Agoda integration, you can ensure your room availability doesn't fall below a set number using the base availability. You can also adjust room rates by specifying a different price to send to Agoda. Click Advanced Settings at the top right.  Select the relevant option from the Room type of your property drop-down.  Choose the relevant option from the Allocation type drop-down:
    
No changes: Keeps the current availability settings without making any adjustments. Choose this option when you’re confident that your existing inventory data is accurate and up-to-date. Number of available beds in available rooms: Sets the availability based on the number of beds in the rooms that are available. For example: if you manage a hostel where each room has multiple beds, and you want to track and sell each bed individually within the available rooms. Number of available beds: Sets the availability based on the total number of beds available. For example, a dormitory, where beds can be booked individually, regardless of which specific room they are in. Number of available rooms: Sets the availability based on the total number of rooms available. Use this option for traditional hotels where you want to set availability based on entire rooms being booked, without focusing on the number of beds in each room.   Enter the relevant number in the Base availability field. Base availability is the minimum number of rooms you always want to keep available, no matter how many you sell. For example, if you set it to 5, your system will always show at least 5 rooms available, even if others are booked. We recommend you do not make any changes here, as it can cause overbooking. Select Yes under Commission included.

Enable the Read-only toggle to update reservations and availability of the room.
Note: Other updates such as rate, minimum stay, stop sell etc, are not affected. Enable the Send price toggle to update only availability for the room type. The price for this rate type won’t be sent to Agoda.  Repeat steps 9-14 for all room types.  Click Save. Show me how to use advanced settings to increase my room rates on AgodaFor example, if you want to send your rate for a room type to Agoda at a 25% higher rate than on your Wix Hotels by HotelRunner calendar:

Select Don't send.  Type 25 in the Adjustment field.  Click the percentage adjustment icon . Click the Increase icon +.  Enable the Main rate toggle.  Enable the Send price toggle. This setup will be transferred to Agoda, and any updates must be managed from Wix after the connection. Update your rooms with 2 weeks of rates and availability in Wix Hotels by HotelRunner. This allows the channel manager to fetch your rooms into the system.How are reservations handled after the connection?All future reservations will be fetched into your Wix dashboard. Reservations with an expired check-in date will not be fetched into your Wix dashboard.Can I connect multiple Hotel IDs or group hotels to one Wix Hotels by HotelRunner account?No, you can only connect one Hotel ID from each channel to a single Wix Hotels by HotelRunner account. Group hotels or different Hotel IDs require separate accounts.What happens to blocked dates on my Agoda calendar after integration?Blocked dates on your Agoda calendar will remain unchanged. To manage these dates, you’ll need to unblock them from the Agoda extranet.What options should I select during the HotelRunner integration on Agoda?You should select reservations, rates and availability, guest reviews, and reporting. Online check-in, content, and photo options are optional but recommended.How do I map room types between Wix Hotels by HotelRunner and Agoda?Use room IDs to match your rooms between the two platforms. Ensure that room types and prices align, such as mapping both “Junior Suite for 1 person” and “Junior Suite for 2 people.”What other uses are there for the advanced settings for the Agoda channel?
Base Availability: This setting ensures you always have a minimum number of rooms available, even if bookings are made. For instance, if you set a base allotment of 5, the system will maintain at least 5 rooms in your inventory, regardless of how many bookings come in. This is particularly beneficial during high-demand periods like festivals or holidays, ensuring that you always have rooms available for direct bookings or last-minute guests. By maintaining this buffer, you can maximize revenue by selling these rooms at higher rates when demand peaks.
 Adjustment: The Adjustment setting allows you to fine-tune the pricing sent to Agoda, independent of your standard rates. For example, if you want to increase your prices on Agoda by 10% to account for platform fees or market demand, you can do this by entering the adjustment. This flexibility helps you optimize revenue across different booking channels by adjusting prices to match specific market conditions, such as higher pricing on Agoda during peak travel seasons while keeping other platforms at regular rates.
 Commission: For the Agoda integration with Wix Hotels by HotelRunner, the Commission field is not needed, and you should leave it blank. This is because Agoda's pricing structure already includes its service fees, so entering additional commission values here could lead to confusion or unintended price changes. By skipping this field, you ensure that your rates remain clear and consistent with Agoda's pricing model, avoiding potential overcharging or undercharging of guests.
Stop Sale: When you activate the 'Stop Sale' option, the selected rate type will be completely closed off from booking on Agoda for all dates. This is useful if you want to manage inventory during renovations, special events, or if you need to prevent bookings due to unexpected closures. For example, if you know that your property will undergo maintenance next month, you can use 'Stop Sale' to block reservations during that period, ensuring that guests are not inconvenienced by the unavailability of your services.
 Read Only: Enabling the 'Read-Only' option ensures that no updates are sent from your system to Agoda for a specific rate type, while still allowing reservations to be displayed in your dashboard. This is useful for hiding promotional rates or derived rates that are meant for special offers and shouldn’t be updated automatically. For example, if you have a promotional rate for long-term stays that you want to keep separate from regular pricing updates, 'Read-Only' ensures that this rate remains static and visible only to specific audiences, without being affected by ongoing pricing adjustments.
 Main Rate: Designating a rate type as the 'Main Rate' makes it the default rate that appears at the top of your calendar. This is beneficial if you have a primary rate that you offer year-round, such as a standard nightly rate. By setting it as the main rate, you ensure that it’s always clearly displayed and easy to manage. For example, if you frequently adjust rates for special events or seasons, having a main rate ensures that your baseline pricing is always visible and can be quickly referenced or changed without confusion.
articles.title: Wix Hotels by HotelRunner: Connecting Agoda to Your Site
articles.html_content:
Agoda integrates with Wix Hotels by HotelRunner to streamline your booking management. Before connecting, ensure all room rates and availability are set on the Wix Hotels by HotelRunner dashboard, as this integration overwrites your Agoda calendar. 

Step 1 | Important information before connecting Agoda

  • Before you connect Agoda as a channel, make sure to set and update the rates and availability of all rooms on the Inventory Calendar. After connection, HotelRunner will transfer all of your inventory to Agoda, overwriting the calendar you have on the channel and all updates must be done from Wix, your extranet calendar will be blocked.
  • Once your Agoda connection is complete, the reservations you already had on Agoda and the new ones you will receive will be forwarded to Wix Hotels by HotelRunner. You can view all your reservations from the Reservations section.
  • Before the integration, to open your slots on Agoda, please update your rooms with 2 weeks of rates and availability for the channel manager to fully register your rooms.
  • Ensure that the extra beds in the Agoda extranet are reset and included in the number of adults to match the panel's total number of people, as this prevents errors.
  • If you have blocked certain dates on your calendar before the integration, once the integration is completed, we cannot overwrite your blocked dates. To manage your calendar, unblock your calendar from the Agoda extranet.

Step 2 | Approve Wix Hotels by HotelRunner for connection on Agoda

To connect Agoda with your Wix Hotels by HotelRunner account, navigate to the Channel Manager in your Wix dashboard and click "Connect" next to Agoda. Log in to the Agoda extranet, go to Property Settings, enable the Channel Manager option by selecting HotelRunner from the drop-down, and click "Save."
Note:
For further assistance, visit the Agoda help center. 

To approve Wix Hotels by HotelRunner for connection with Agoda:

  1. Go to Channel Manager in the Wix Hotels by HotelRunner dashboard.
  2. Click Connect next to Agoda. 
  3. Click Connect with Agoda. 
  4. Log in to the Agoda extranet.
    Note: Make sure to log in to Agoda using the main host login information. You should not have another Agoda account open in your browser during this process because it will automatically connect to that account.
  5. Click Settings at the top.
  6. Click Property Settings. 
  7. Click Optional Settings. 
  8. Select the Enable channel manager mode checkbox and choose HotelRunner from the drop-down. 
  9. Click Save. 

Step 3 | Map your room types on Agoda

To map room types, find your room IDs on the Agoda extranet in Rooms under Property, and then input these IDs in the 'Room type' mapping section of the Wix Hotels by HotelRunner dashboard. Agoda automatically sends your rooms to Wix Hotels by HotelRunner with their custom names. For this reason, you can use room IDs to distinguish your rooms from each other. Room IDs appear in the bottom right of the Wix Hotels by HotelRunner.  
Make sure to match room availability and prices. You can then use the advanced settings feature to further adjust prices. Click "Complete mapping" once all room types and rates are set.
Important:
  • In the channels where you see the HotelRunner standard rate, it should always be selected as “Main Rate” and “Don't Send”.
  • The Agoda extranet currency and the selected currency on the mapping page must be the same.

To map your room types:

  1. Collect your room IDs on the Agoda extranet in Rooms under Property.
  2. In another tab on your browser, go to Channel Manager in the Wix Hotels by HotelRunner dashboard. 
  3. Click View channel details next to Agoda.
  4. Click Fetch room types. 
  5. Hover over each room type and click Expand. 
  6. Match your Agoda room types with your room types on Wix Hotels by HotelRunner using the drop-downs.
    Note: Make sure to double-check you are matching the correct room types across both platforms, as there may be differences in room type names. 
  7. Click Save at the bottom. 

Step 4 | Adjust your advanced settings

With the advanced settings for the Agoda integration, you can ensure your room availability doesn't fall below a set number using the base availability. You can also adjust room rates by specifying a different price to send to Agoda. Additionally, you can choose to stop sales for certain rate types or mark rates as read-only to prevent updates.
Note:
On the Agoda extranet, we recommend you set all relevant rate plans to Active with a maximum arrival date as the year "9999".

To adjust your advanced settings:

  1. Go to Channel Manager in the Wix Hotels by HotelRunner dashboard.
  2. Click View channel details next to Agoda.
  3. Hover over the relevant room type and click Expand.
  4. Click Advanced Settings at the top right. 
  5. Select the relevant option from the Room type of your property drop-down. 
  6. Choose the relevant option from the Allocation type drop-down:
    • No changes: Keeps the current availability settings without making any adjustments. Choose this option when you’re confident that your existing inventory data is accurate and up-to-date.
    • Number of available beds in available rooms: Sets the availability based on the number of beds in the rooms that are available. For example: if you manage a hostel where each room has multiple beds, and you want to track and sell each bed individually within the available rooms.
    • Number of available beds: Sets the availability based on the total number of beds available. For example, a dormitory, where beds can be booked individually, regardless of which specific room they are in.
    • Number of available rooms: Sets the availability based on the total number of rooms available. Use this option for traditional hotels where you want to set availability based on entire rooms being booked, without focusing on the number of beds in each room.
  7. Enter the relevant number in the Base availability field. Base availability is the minimum number of rooms you always want to keep available, no matter how many you sell. For example, if you set it to 5, your system will always show at least 5 rooms available, even if others are booked. We recommend you do not make any changes here, as it can cause overbooking.
  8. Select Yes under Commission included. 
  1. Enter the relevant Adjustment amount. 
  2. Choose either a percentage adjustment  or a monetary  adjustment, and choose whether the adjustment is an increase + or a decrease -. 
  3. Enable the Main rate toggle to set this rate type as the main rate.
  4. Enable the Read-only toggle to update reservations and availability of the room.
    Note: Other updates such as rate, minimum stay, stop sell etc, are not affected.
  5. Enable the Send price toggle to update only availability for the room type. The price for this rate type won’t be sent to Agoda. 
  6. Repeat steps 9-14 for all room types. 
  7. Click Save. 

Show me how to use advanced settings to increase my room rates on Agoda

For example, if you want to send your rate for a room type to Agoda at a 25% higher rate than on your Wix Hotels by HotelRunner calendar:

  1. In the drop-down next to the room type, select your room on Wix that corresponds to the room in the target channel.
  2. Select Don't send. 
  3. Type 25 in the Adjustment field. 
  4. Click the percentage adjustment icon .
  5. Click the Increase icon +. 
  6. Enable the Main rate toggle. 
  7. Enable the Send price toggle.
  8. Repeat steps 1-6 above for all relevant room types. 
  9. Click Save at the bottom.  

Step 5 | Activate the Agoda connection

After completing your room mapping, click Activate. Once the Agoda connection is complete, all your inventory (rates, availability, and restrictions) on your Wix Hotels by HotelRunner calendar will be transferred to your Agoda account. You can review and update your room mapping from the Channel Manager in the dashboard at any time. 

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

Click a question below to learn more. 

What should I do before connecting Wix Hotels by HotelRunner with Agoda?

Make sure all your room rates and availability are set on the inventory calendar in the Wix Hotels by HotelRunner dashboard. This setup will be transferred to Agoda, and any updates must be managed from Wix after the connection. 

Update your rooms with 2 weeks of rates and availability in Wix Hotels by HotelRunner. This allows the channel manager to fetch your rooms into the system.

How are reservations handled after the connection?

All future reservations will be fetched into your Wix dashboard. Reservations with an expired check-in date will not be fetched into your Wix dashboard.

Can I connect multiple Hotel IDs or group hotels to one Wix Hotels by HotelRunner account?

No, you can only connect one Hotel ID from each channel to a single Wix Hotels by HotelRunner account. Group hotels or different Hotel IDs require separate accounts.

What happens to blocked dates on my Agoda calendar after integration?

Blocked dates on your Agoda calendar will remain unchanged. To manage these dates, you’ll need to unblock them from the Agoda extranet.

What options should I select during the HotelRunner integration on Agoda?

You should select reservations, rates and availability, guest reviews, and reporting. Online check-in, content, and photo options are optional but recommended.

How do I map room types between Wix Hotels by HotelRunner and Agoda?

Use room IDs to match your rooms between the two platforms. Ensure that room types and prices align, such as mapping both “Junior Suite for 1 person” and “Junior Suite for 2 people.”

What other uses are there for the advanced settings for the Agoda channel?

  • Base Availability: This setting ensures you always have a minimum number of rooms available, even if bookings are made. For instance, if you set a base allotment of 5, the system will maintain at least 5 rooms in your inventory, regardless of how many bookings come in. This is particularly beneficial during high-demand periods like festivals or holidays, ensuring that you always have rooms available for direct bookings or last-minute guests. By maintaining this buffer, you can maximize revenue by selling these rooms at higher rates when demand peaks.
  • Adjustment: The Adjustment setting allows you to fine-tune the pricing sent to Agoda, independent of your standard rates. For example, if you want to increase your prices on Agoda by 10% to account for platform fees or market demand, you can do this by entering the adjustment. This flexibility helps you optimize revenue across different booking channels by adjusting prices to match specific market conditions, such as higher pricing on Agoda during peak travel seasons while keeping other platforms at regular rates.
  • Commission: For the Agoda integration with Wix Hotels by HotelRunner, the Commission field is not needed, and you should leave it blank. This is because Agoda's pricing structure already includes its service fees, so entering additional commission values here could lead to confusion or unintended price changes. By skipping this field, you ensure that your rates remain clear and consistent with Agoda's pricing model, avoiding potential overcharging or undercharging of guests.

  • Stop Sale: When you activate the 'Stop Sale' option, the selected rate type will be completely closed off from booking on Agoda for all dates. This is useful if you want to manage inventory during renovations, special events, or if you need to prevent bookings due to unexpected closures. For example, if you know that your property will undergo maintenance next month, you can use 'Stop Sale' to block reservations during that period, ensuring that guests are not inconvenienced by the unavailability of your services.
  • Read Only: Enabling the 'Read-Only' option ensures that no updates are sent from your system to Agoda for a specific rate type, while still allowing reservations to be displayed in your dashboard. This is useful for hiding promotional rates or derived rates that are meant for special offers and shouldn’t be updated automatically. For example, if you have a promotional rate for long-term stays that you want to keep separate from regular pricing updates, 'Read-Only' ensures that this rate remains static and visible only to specific audiences, without being affected by ongoing pricing adjustments.
  • Main Rate: Designating a rate type as the 'Main Rate' makes it the default rate that appears at the top of your calendar. This is beneficial if you have a primary rate that you offer year-round, such as a standard nightly rate. By setting it as the main rate, you ensure that it’s always clearly displayed and easy to manage. For example, if you frequently adjust rates for special events or seasons, having a main rate ensures that your baseline pricing is always visible and can be quickly referenced or changed without confusion.

question: How can I retrieve my Wix domain if it has entered the redemption period?
answer:
To retrieve a Wix domain that has entered the redemption period, follow these steps:

1. [Go to your Domains page](https://premium.wix.com/wix/api/mpContainerStaticController#/domains) and locate the relevant domain.
2. Click **Keep Domain** within the redemption notification after reviewing the redemption fee information.
3. Enter your payment details in the checkout.
4. Click **Submit Payment**.

**Note**: Retrieving your domain can take up to 7 days to complete. We'll notify you of any progress via the email associated with your Wix account.

articles.title: Retrieving an Expired Domain During the Redemption Period
articles.html_content:
When a domain expires, whether due to payment failure or auto-renew being turned off, it enters a grace period lasting about 30 days. During this time, you can retrieve your domain without any additional cost. Learn more about the domain life cycle.
If you do not retrieve your domain during this time, your domain enters the redemption period. You can still retrieve your domain during the redemption period. However, for most domains you will need to pay a redemption fee to keep your domain. 
At the end of the redemption period, you cannot renew your domain name and it is released. At this point, the domain can be registered by another user.
In this article, learn about:
  • Checking if your domain is in the redemption period
  • Retrieving a Wix domain in redemption
  • FAQs

Checking if your domain is in the redemption period

Use whois.com to check if your domain is in the redemption period. If you wish to retrieve the domain by purchasing the subscription, you can do so by contacting your domain host.

To check your domain:

  1. Go to www.whois.com
  2. Enter your domain name.
    Note: This is how the status of your domain is displayed in whois.com:
  1. (Optional) If your domain is in the redemption period and you wish to repurchase it:
    • For domains registered at Wix: Follow the steps below. 
    • For domains registered elsewhere: Contact your domain registrar.

Retrieving a Wix domain in redemption

If your domain is registered at Wix and has entered the redemption period, you can retrieve it from the Domains page in your Wix account.

To retrieve a Wix domain:

  1. Go to your Domains page and locate the relevant domain. 
  2. Click Keep Domain within the redemption notification after reviewing the redemption fee information. 
  1. Enter your payment details in the checkout.
  2. Click Submit Payment.
    Note: Retrieving your domain can take up to 7 days to complete. We'll notify you of any progress via the email associated with your Wix account. 

FAQs

We are here to help with all your questions. Click a question below to learn more.

Does the grace period apply for all domains?

The grace period does not apply for domains ending in the following: 
  • .at
  • .be
  • .ch
  • .co.at
  • .com.br
  • .or.at
  • .de
  • .fr
  • .mx
  • .nl
These domain extensions bypass the grace period and go straight to the redemption period. Learn more about domain endings that do not have a grace period.

Does the redemption period apply for all domains?

In rare cases, the domain may not be available once it enters the redemption period. This is due to a decision by the domain registrar. 

Wix resells domains from a 3rd party domain registrar, who may decide to exercise their right to privately auction the domain name. 

To avoid this happening, we recommend that you resolve any payment issues before the domain is due to enter the redemption period, in order to keep the domain under your ownership.

How much is the redemption fee?

The redemption fee can vary depending on a number of factors. Not all domains are subject to the same redemption fee amounts. You'll see the required amount displayed within your redemption notification on your Domains page. 

Redemption fees may also be subject to local taxes. Any applicable taxes are added to the total on checkout.

question: How can I preview the password protection window for a page on my Wix site?
answer:
To view your password protection window on a Wix site, follow these steps:

1. [Publish](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-publishing-your-site) your site.
2. Access your [live site](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-publishing-your-site#viewing-your-live-site).
3. Navigate to the password protected page.

**Important:** You can only see the password window on your live site. It does not appear when previewing your site.

question: How can I add and customize a 'Services' widget on my Wix Member App?
answer:
To add and customize a 'Services' widget on your Wix Member App, follow these steps:

1. Go to your site in the [Wix App](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-owner-app-an-overview).
2. Tap **Manage** ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/8769cf44-f342-494c-b25f-cc98c9da3e82/2021/04/12/3fc0f98c-0997-47b3-b7bd-6ae31a67e078/ce9c0fe5-f60d-4448-8fc2-9ba4cf636f93.png) at the bottom.
3. Tap **Site & App**.
4. Tap **Customize** under **Mobile Apps**.
5. Tap the **Screen** drop-down at the top and choose the screen in which you want to place the widget.
6. Tap **+ Add Element**.
7. Tap **Bookings** at the top.
8. Tap the **Services** element to add it.

   - **Element title:** Enable the **Element title** toggle to show a title at the top of the element. Then enter the text you want to use.

9. Tap **Add** at the top right.

This will add a list of all your services where your clients can book services straight from the screen. Clients can also filter services by location.

articles.title: Wix Member Apps: Adding Bookings Widgets on the Wix Member Apps
articles.html_content:
Include widgets on your Wix Member Apps to show your content and what you offer. To help manage your schedule, you can add upcoming bookings, agenda, services, and upcoming sessions widgets to your app.

Once you've added these elements, choose where to display them, and manage, edit, or remove them for a personalized experience. Place the elements where members can clearly see and interact with them.
In this article, learn more about:
  • Display your Bookings widgets
  • Frequently asked questions (FAQs)

Displaying your Bookings widgets

Select the Booking widgets you want to include on your member apps and customize them to your liking. Rename widgets, select which screens in your member apps to display them on, choose which devices are able to see these elements, and more. 

To display your Bookings widgets:

  1. Go to your site in the Wix App.
  2. Tap Manage  at the bottom.
  3. Tap Site & App.
  4. Tap Customize under Mobile Apps.  
    Note: If you haven't set up the Member App your members will use, tap the drop-down under Mobile Apps then choose your preferred members app.
  5. Tap the Screen drop-down at the top and choose the screen in which you want to place the widget. 
  6. Tap + Add Element. 
  7. Tap Bookings at the top. 
  8. Tap the element you want to add:

Upcoming bookings

Remind clients of their upcoming bookings, allow them to easily book a new appointment and see their booking history.

  1. Edit the following details:
    • Element title: Enable the Element title toggle to show a title at the top of the element. Then enter the text you want to use.
    • Show avatar preview: Enable the Show avatar preview toggle to show avatars of participants who have booked the sessions already.
    • Empty state text: Add a message for clients who have no upcoming sessions booked. 
    • Online sessions: Choose a layout for virtual sessions: With image or Text only.
    • Booking history: Enable the Booking history toggle to show previously booked classes and appointments so members can quickly book again. 
    • Visibility: Choose which devices you want to show these elements: All, Android, or  iOS. 
  2. Tap Add at the top right.

Agenda (Weekly timetable)

Add a weekly timetable and make it easier for your clients to find and book the right service. 

  1. Edit the following details:
    • Element title: Enable the Element title toggle to show a title at the top of the element. Then enter the text you want to use.
    • Element visibility: Choose which devices you want to show these elements: Android devices, iOS, or All. 
  2. Tap Add at the top right.

Services

A list of all your services where your clients can book services straight from the screen. Clients can also filter services by location.

  1. Edit the following details:
    • Element title: Enable the Element title toggle to show a title at the top of the element. Then enter the text you want to use.
    • Element visibility: Choose which devices you want to show these elements: Android devices, iOS, or All. 
  2. Tap Add at the top right.

Upcoming sessions

A preview of upcoming sessions.

  1. Edit the following details:
    • Element title: Enable the Element title toggle to show a title at the top of the element. Then enter the text you want to use.
    • Element visibility: Choose which devices you want to show these elements: Android devices, iOS, or All. 
  2. Tap Add at the top right.

FAQs

Click a question below to learn more.

Can I move widgets from one screen to another?

Yes. Once you add a widget, you can move it to another screen. Here's how:
  1. Tap the Screen drop-down at the top and select the relevant screen.
  2. Tap the Edit icon   at the top right of the element.
  3. Tap Customize element.
  4. Tap the Choose screen drop-down under Location and select which screen you want the element to appear on.
  5. Tap Save at the top right.

How do I customize an existing widget?

To customize an existing widget:
  1. Tap Manage  at the bottom of your screen.
  2. Tap Site & App.
  3. Tap Customize under Mobile Apps.  
  4. Tap the Screen drop-down at the top and select the relevant screen.
  5. Tap the Edit icon   at the top right of an existing element.
  6. Tap Customize element.
  7. Edit the element and tap Save at the top right.

Can I delete a widget?

Yes. Once you delete a widget, you are still able to add the same element again, but any customizations made will need to be reapplied.

  1. Go to your site in the Wix App.
  2. Tap Manage  at the bottom.
  3. Tap Site & App.
  4. Tap Customize under Mobile Apps. 
  5. Tap the Screen drop-down at the top and select the relevant screen.
  6. Tap the Edit icon   at the top right of the element.
  7. Tap Delete element.
  8. Tap Delete element to confirm.

How do I add the same widget to two different screens?

You can duplicate a widget, then move the duplicate widget to another screen. 

To add the same widget to two screens:
  1. Tap Manage  at the bottom.
  2. Tap Site & App.
  3. Tap Customize under Mobile Apps. 
  4. Tap the Screen drop-down at the top and select the relevant screen.
  5. Tap the Edit icon   at the top right of the element.
  6. Tap Duplicate.
  7. Tap Edit icon   at the top right of the duplicated element.
  8. Tap Customize element.
  9. Tap the Choose screen drop-down under Location and select which screen you want the element to appear on.
  10. Tap Save at the top right.

How can I change the order of my widgets?

You can move your widgets up or down in the screen to organize them.

To reorder your widgets:
  1. Tap Manage  at the bottom.
  2. Tap Site & App.
  3. Tap Customize under Mobile Apps. 
  4. Tap the Screen drop-down at the top and select the relevant screen.
  5. Tap the Edit icon   at the top right of the element.
  6. Tap the relevant option: Move up or Move down.

Can clients filter what they see on widgets?

Yes. In their Member App (Fit by Wix or the Spaces App), on the Agenda page or the Weekly Timetable, clients can click Filters to view sessions by location, service or staff member.

question: How can I resolve issues with missing podcast episodes in the Wix Podcast Player?
answer:
If you are missing podcast episodes, check the following:

* The episodes have been successfully added to the episode page.
* Your RSS feed is properly set up to display the episodes.
* All episodes are working correctly.

articles.contents:
Wix Podcast Player: General Troubleshooting
The majority of podcast issues can be resolved by doing the following:Disconnecting and reconnecting to your internet. Clearing your cache and cookies.Opening your podcast in a different browser. If you are still experiencing issues, select your issue below to learn how to resolve it. Unable to Connect My Podcast to the Wix Podcast AppMake sure you are using the feed RSS URL and not a link to iTunes or another podcast player.


Note: The Wix Podcast Player is an RSS reader. Wix does not host your podcast. You will need to check that your permissions are set correctly with your host. Learn more about connecting your RSS feed.Unable to Play Audio/Video in the Wix Podcast AppYou can test your RSS feed by checking that your audio/video plays correctly in other free RSS readers e.g. feedly.com.Missing Podcast EpisodesIf you are missing podcast episodes, check the following:The episodes have been successfully added to the episode page. Your RSS feed is properly set up to display the episodes.All episodes are working correctly.Still need help?If you still need assistance with the Wix Podcast Player, please contact us and prepare the following details:
A detailed description of the issue you are experiencing. The site and page where your Wix Podcast Player is located. The RSS feed URL. Include what happened and what you've already tried.
articles.title: Wix Podcast Player: General Troubleshooting
articles.html_content:
The majority of podcast issues can be resolved by doing the following:
  • Disconnecting and reconnecting to your internet. 
  • Clearing your cache and cookies.
  • Opening your podcast in a different browser. 
If you are still experiencing issues, select your issue below to learn how to resolve it. 

Unable to Connect My Podcast to the Wix Podcast App

Make sure you are using the feed RSS URL and not a link to iTunes or another podcast player.


Note: The Wix Podcast Player is an RSS reader. Wix does not host your podcast. You will need to check that your permissions are set correctly with your host. Learn more about connecting your RSS feed.

Unable to Play Audio/Video in the Wix Podcast App

You can test your RSS feed by checking that your audio/video plays correctly in other free RSS readers e.g. feedly.com.

Missing Podcast Episodes

If you are missing podcast episodes, check the following:
  • The episodes have been successfully added to the episode page. 
  • Your RSS feed is properly set up to display the episodes.
  • All episodes are working correctly.

Still need help?

If you still need assistance with the Wix Podcast Player, please contact us and prepare the following details:
  • A detailed description of the issue you are experiencing.
  • The site and page where your Wix Podcast Player is located.
  • The RSS feed URL.
  • Include what happened and what you've already tried.

question: How can I automatically generate invoices for online paid orders in Wix Restaurants?
answer:
To automatically generate an invoice for every order paid online in Wix Restaurants, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Checkout Settings](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Go%20to%20Checkout%20Settings&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/ecom-platform/checkout-settings) in your site's dashboard.
2. Enable the **Automatically create invoices for every new order paid online** toggle under **Payments**.

### Note
If you issue a partial or complete refund on an order, the invoice doesn't update to reflect the refund amount.

articles.contents:
Wix Restaurants: Automatically Creating Invoices for Paid Orders
Generate invoices for all restaurant orders paid online.Invoices are only created for:
Orders paid online through your site (e.g. not with the manual payment method). Orders you haven't yet manually created an invoice.To automatically generate an invoice for every order:
Go to Checkout Settings in your site's dashboard. Enable the Automatically create invoices for every new order paid online toggle under Payments.Note:If you issue a partial or complete refund on an order, the invoice doesn't update to reflect the refund amount.
articles.title: Wix Restaurants: Automatically Creating Invoices for Paid Orders
articles.html_content:
Generate invoices for all restaurant orders paid online.
Invoices are only created for:
  • Orders paid online through your site (e.g. not with the manual payment method).
  • Orders you haven't yet manually created an invoice.

To automatically generate an invoice for every order:

  1. Go to Checkout Settings in your site's dashboard.
  2. Enable the Automatically create invoices for every new order paid online toggle under Payments.
Note:
If you issue a partial or complete refund on an order, the invoice doesn't update to reflect the refund amount.

question: How can I add related posts to my Wix blog post?
answer:
To add related posts to your Wix blog post, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Blog in your site's dashboard.](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20My%20Blog&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/blog)
2. Click **Create New Post** or **Edit** to edit an existing post.
3. Create or edit the post to include the relevant information.
4. Click the **Settings** tab on the left side panel.
5. Click the **Advanced** tab.
6. Click **Choose Posts** to choose additional posts.
7. Select the relevant posts.
8. Click **Done**.

articles.contents:
Wix Blog: Adding Related Posts to Your Blog
Your Blog Post page automatically displays a Related Posts element at the bottom of every post to allow your readers to discover similar content to what they are currently reading. You can select up to 3 related posts for each blog post.In this article, learn more about:
Adding related posts Frequently asked questions (FAQs)Adding related postsStart by adding related posts to individual blog posts. Go to the desired post and select up to 3 related posts to accompany it.To add related posts:
Go to Blog in your site's dashboard. Click Create New Post or Edit to edit an existing post. Create or edit the post to include the relevant information. Click the Settings tab on the left side panel. Click the Advanced tab.  Click Choose Posts to choose additional posts. 
Select the relevant posts.
Click Done. FAQsHow do I remove a related post?You can remove a related post that you've selected by going back in to Choose Posts and deselecting the relevant checkbox. Click Done to save your changes. Can I change the settings of the Related Posts section?Related Posts do not have their own dedicated settings. The settings that appear here are pulled from the Post Page settings. Can I change the location of the Related Posts section?No, related posts always appear below the blog post. It is not possible to choose where related posts appear on a post page.
articles.title: Wix Blog: Adding Related Posts to Your Blog
articles.html_content:
Your Blog Post page automatically displays a Related Posts element at the bottom of every post to allow your readers to discover similar content to what they are currently reading. You can select up to 3 related posts for each blog post.
In this article, learn more about:
  • Adding related posts
  • Frequently asked questions (FAQs)

Adding related posts

Start by adding related posts to individual blog posts. Go to the desired post and select up to 3 related posts to accompany it.

To add related posts:

  1. Go to Blog in your site's dashboard.
  2. Click Create New Post or Edit to edit an existing post.
  3. Create or edit the post to include the relevant information.
  4. Click the Settings tab on the left side panel.
  5. Click the Advanced tab. 
  6. Click Choose Posts to choose additional posts. 
  1. Select the relevant posts.
  1. Click Done. 

FAQs

How do I remove a related post?

You can remove a related post that you've selected by going back in to Choose Posts and deselecting the relevant checkbox. Click Done to save your changes. 

Can I change the settings of the Related Posts section?

Related Posts do not have their own dedicated settings. The settings that appear here are pulled from the Post Page settings. 

Can I change the location of the Related Posts section?

No, related posts always appear below the blog post. It is not possible to choose where related posts appear on a post page.

question: How can I delete a staff member from Wix Bookings using the Wix app?
answer:
To delete a staff member from Wix Bookings using the Wix app, follow these steps:

1. Go to your site in the Wix app.
2. Tap **Manage** ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/8769cf44-f342-494c-b25f-cc98c9da3e82/2021/04/12/3fc0f98c-0997-47b3-b7bd-6ae31a67e078/ce9c0fe5-f60d-4448-8fc2-9ba4cf636f93.png) at the bottom.
3. Scroll down and tap **Settings**.
4. Tap **Booking Settings**.
5. Tap the **Staff** tab.
6. Tap the relevant staff member.
   ![A screenshot where to find staff in your Wix app.](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/e8d9ab8e-d3c2-427f-a4f2-1e90c04f91d4/2024/11/04/cb79f208-ed93-45ac-8109-6373b893d11d/98cfc844-b922-408f-969d-d99a68507401.png)
7. Scroll down and tap **Delete Staff Member** at the bottom.
8. Tap **Delete** to confirm.

Keep in mind, your site needs at least one staff member at all times. You (the owner) become the default staff member if you don't have any other staff members.

articles.contents:
Wix Bookings: Deleting a Staff Member
You can easily remove staff members from Wix Bookings whenever you need to. All services require at least one assigned staff member. So, before you delete a staff member, make sure to cancel or reassign any services tied to them.In this article, learn more about:
Deleting a staff member Frequently asked questions (FAQs)Deleting a staff memberDelete a staff member directly from your site's dashboard, the Wix app or the Wix Studio app. Keep in mind, your site needs at least one staff member at all times. You (the owner) become the default staff member if you don't have any other staff members. DashboardWix appWix Studio app
Go to Staff in your site's dashboard. Hover over the relevant staff member and click the More Actions icon  . Click Delete.
Click Delete to confirm.
Go to your site in the Wix app. Tap Manage  at the bottom. Scroll down and tap Settings.  Tap Booking Settings.  Tap the Staff tab. Tap the relevant staff member.
Scroll down and tap Delete Staff Member at the bottom. Tap Delete to confirm.
Go to your site in the Wix Studio app. Tap Manage. Scroll down and tap Settings. Tap Booking Settings. Tap the Staff tab. Tap the relevant staff member.
Scroll down and tap Delete staff member. Tap Delete to confirm.FAQsClick below for answers to our most common questions about deleting staff members. Does deleting a staff member impact appointments?Yes, deleting a staff member impacts appointments. If there is only one staff member assigned to the appointment, it will no longer be available. If there are multiple staff members assigned to the appointment, the appointment will still be available for booking. The availability of the remaining staff members is displayed.Does deleting a staff member impact classes or courses?Yes, deleting a staff member impacts classes/courses.

articles.title: Wix Bookings: Deleting a Staff Member
articles.html_content:
You can easily remove staff members from Wix Bookings whenever you need to. All services require at least one assigned staff member. So, before you delete a staff member, make sure to cancel or reassign any services tied to them.

In this article, learn more about:
  • Deleting a staff member
  • Frequently asked questions (FAQs)

Deleting a staff member

Delete a staff member directly from your site's dashboard, the Wix app or the Wix Studio app. 

Keep in mind, your site needs at least one staff member at all times. You (the owner) become the default staff member if you don't have any other staff members. 
Dashboard
Wix app
Wix Studio app
  1. Go to Staff in your site's dashboard.
  2. Hover over the relevant staff member and click the More Actions icon  .
  3. Click Delete.
  1. Click Delete to confirm.
  1. Go to your site in the Wix app.
  2. Tap Manage  at the bottom.
  3. Scroll down and tap Settings. 
  4. Tap Booking Settings. 
  5. Tap the Staff tab.
  6. Tap the relevant staff member.
  1. Scroll down and tap Delete Staff Member at the bottom.
  2. Tap Delete to confirm.
  1. Go to your site in the Wix Studio app.
  2. Tap Manage.
  3. Scroll down and tap Settings.
  4. Tap Booking Settings.
  5. Tap the Staff tab.
  6. Tap the relevant staff member.
  1. Scroll down and tap Delete staff member.
  2. Tap Delete to confirm.

FAQs

Click below for answers to our most common questions about deleting staff members. 

Does deleting a staff member impact appointments?

Yes, deleting a staff member impacts appointments. If there is only one staff member assigned to the appointment, it will no longer be available. If there are multiple staff members assigned to the appointment, the appointment will still be available for booking. The availability of the remaining staff members is displayed.

Does deleting a staff member impact classes or courses?

Yes, deleting a staff member impacts classes/courses.
  • The remaining available sessions continue to have the deleted staff member assigned, and are bookable. We recommend that you replace the assigned staff member.
  • If the session is integrated with Zoom - the Zoom link is retained.
  • Existing sessions that are already booked keep the deleted staff member as assigned.
  • On your live site, the name of the staff member that has been deleted still appears next to services, until they are replaced with another staff member.

How do I reassign classes or courses to a new staff member?

Learn how to reassign any class or course the staff member is assigned to.

How do I reassign appointments to a new staff member?

Learn how to reassign any appointment the staff member is assigned to.

What should I do if I want to delete a staff member who is assigned a member role?

If you assigned the staff member to a Bookings Staff Member role, remove them from their collaborator role.

question: How can I connect Paysafecash as a payment method through Skrill on my Wix site?
answer:
To connect Paysafecash as a payment method through Skrill on your Wix site, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Accept Payments](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Set%20Up%20Payments&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7b%7bmetaSiteId%7d%7d/payments/) in your site's dashboard.

   **Tip:** Check your business location at the top right. If incorrect, click the drop-down menu to change it.

2. Click **See More Payment Options.**
3. Click **Connect** next to Paysafecash.
4. Depending on whether you are creating a new Skrill account, or have an existing account, follow the instructions:

   **Have an account**
   1. Enter your Merchant ID, E-Mail, Secret Word, and MQI/API Password. **Tip:** Sign in to your Skrill account and go to **Settings > Developer Settings** to create your Secret Word and API Password. Your Merchant ID can be seen at the top right of your Skrill account.
   2. Click **Connect**.

   **Don't have an account**
   1. Click [**Create Skrill account**](https://signup.skrill.com/onboarding/#/?rdu=onboarding&rid=92359478&lang=EN).
   2. Register your account with Skrill.
   3. Once your Skrill account has been verified, you can retrieve your Merchant ID from the top right of your Skrill account.
   4. Still in Skrill, go to **Settings > Developer Settings** to create your Secret Word and API Password.
   5. Return to the [Accept Payments tab](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Set%20Up%20Payments&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7b%7bmetaSiteId%7d%7d/payments/) (repeat steps 1-4) and follow the steps under **Have an account** to connect your account.

Once connected, your checkout will be active for your chosen payment method(s). You need to have your account successfully verified to receive payouts.

  2. Click See More Payment Options.
  3. Click Connect next to Paysafecash.
  1. Depending on whether you are creating a new Skrill account, or have an existing account, follow the instructions:

Have an account

How can I tell if a payment method is active?

In order to accept online payments, you must connect a payment provider. 
Once connected, your checkout will be active for your chosen payment method(s).

Is my currency supported?

Be aware that payments will fail If you are using an unsupported currency.

Payouts are managed by your payment provider. If your provider is a third-party provider, contact them directly.

If your customers are experiencing payment failures, you may be able to fix the issue by troubleshooting issues for accepting payments.

If you’re having trouble connecting your payment provider, you may be able to fix the issue by troubleshooting common connection issues.

question: How can I customize images for different languages using the Wix Editor?
answer:
To customize images for different languages using the Wix Editor, follow these steps:

1. [Go to your editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26).
2. Click the **Switch languages** drop-down menu at the top of the Wix Editor.
3. Select the language you want to edit.
4. Click **Pages & Menu** on the left side of the editor.
5. Select the page you want to edit.
6. Select the relevant image on your page.
7. Click **Edit Translation**.
8. Set up your image for the language:
   * Change the image: Click **Change** to select a different image for the secondary language.
   * Change the image behaviors:
     + Select an option under **When image is clicked**.
     + Select an option under **What does this link to?**
   * Change the alt text:
     + Enter an image description under **What's in the image?**
     + Enter tooltip text under **Does this image have a tooltip?**

**Tip:** If you've specified different images for each language, changing the main language image won't affect the others. However, if an image hasn't been set for a specific language, updating the main language image will change it for all languages.

Customizing galleries per language

Customize your site's galleries for each of your languages. You can replace existing images, add more images, and change their order. Additionally, you can adjust the settings for each image in your gallery, including alt text, description, and the image link.
Important:
  • You can customize the following galleries: Grid Galleries, Slider Galleries, Honeycomb (diamonds and triangle), Animated Slide, Freestyle, 3d Slideshow, 3d Carousel.

Which images cannot be changed per language?

You are limited in changing certain types of images: strip backgrounds, vector art (.svg files), Pro Gallery images, lightbox images, and images that appear in apps. You cannot change these images per language, but you can adjust their SEO settings, such as alt text, title, and description.

Is it possible to only adjust an existing image for each language?

Yes. If you want to use the same image but change it slightly per language, go to your editor, select the language you want to update, select the page in your site and the relevant image. Click Edit Translation and then select Adjust  to access the Wix Photo Studio.

Tip: Try our AI Image Editor to edit your image in your desired style.

How do I select and change images for different languages on my site?

You can upload your own images, select stock images, or create your own image with AI. 

To change your image, go to your editor, select the language you want to update, select the page in your site and the relevant image. Click Edit Translation and then click Change  to select a different image for your secondary language. You can now decide what you want to do: Click Add Images and select an image from the Media Manager or Create an AI image. 

Why should I translate alt text?

Translating alt text for your images improves your site's SEO as it helps your site appear in search results in other languages too. Search engines read the text in your site's HTML code to understand the images. This improves your site's visibility and relevance.
Alt text also enhances accessibility by allowing screen readers to describe images to visually impaired site visitors.

question: How can I add and manage multiple languages on my Wix site using Wix Multilingual?
answer:
To add and manage multiple languages on your Wix site using Wix Multilingual, follow these steps:

1. **Choose Translation Method**: Decide whether to translate your content manually or automatically. This allows your entire site to be translated instantly into a language of your choice.

2. **Manage Language Visibility**: You can choose to make the new language available to visitors or keep it hidden while you're working on it.

3. **Navigate Languages in Studio Editor**: Click the drop-down menu showing the current language in the top bar of the Studio editor to select a language to work on, or click **Manage Languages** to access the Multilingual dashboard.

4. **Use the Translation Panel**: Access the translation panel using the newly added languages dropdown at the top of your editor. You can translate your site's content automatically or manually for a tailored multilingual experience.

5. **Translate Site and App Content**: Translate both your site and apps content in one place on your site's dashboard - The [Translation Manager](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-multilingual-using-the-translation-manager). Add and translate as many languages as you want as your customer base and business grow.

6. **Manage Language Display**: Choose what languages to show or hide, and delete any languages that you no longer wish to display.

### Important
- Once you've selected your site's main language, you cannot change it to a different language. If this is something you'd like to see in the future, you can [vote for this feature](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-multilingual-request-changing-your-sites-main-language).
- We recommend reviewing our list of translatable content before translating your site. [Learn more about what apps can and can't be translated with Wix Multilingual](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-multilingual-translatable-content#apps-you-can-and-cant-translate).

### Tip
Wix Multilingual affects your site's [regional settings](https://support.wix.com/en/article/changing-your-sites-regional-settings), automatically adjusting the date format, numbers, and other metrics to that specific locale.

question: How can I adjust the layout of my pricing plans on a mobile site using the Wix Editor?
answer:
To adjust the layout of your pricing plans on a mobile site using the Wix Editor, follow these steps:

1. [Go to your editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26).
2. Click the Switch to Mobile icon at the top of the editor.
3. Go to your Plans & Pricing page:
   
   1. Click **Pages & Menu** on the left side of the editor.
   2. Click your Plans & Pricing page.
4. Click the Pricing Plans element on the page.
5. Click **Settings**.
6. Click **Layout**.

question: How can I add free media from Wix using the Wix Editor?
answer:
To add free media from Wix using the Wix Editor, follow these steps:

1. [Go to the editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26).
2. Click **Media** on the left side of the editor.
3. Click **Show More** under **Free Wix Images** or under **Free Wix Videos.**
4. Select the media you want to add.
5. Click **Add to Page**.

**Tip:** To view more options for media files that you like, hover over an image and click the **Related images** icon. Please note, not all media files have related media available.

question: Does Wix support CAA records for domain connections?
answer: Currently, CAA records are not supported by Wix. If you have connected via pointing method, please make sure to remove the existing CAA record at your domain host's side.
